{{External|rs|rsc}} {{Has quick guide}} {{Infobox Quest |name = Romeo & Juliet |number = 4 |image = [[File:Romeo & Juliet.png|300px]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |series = None |developer = [[Rob Law|Rob L]], [[Paul Gower]] }} '''Romeo & Juliet''' is one of the original six [[quests]] released with the launch of ''RuneScape Classic''. The quest roughly follows the storyline of the {{Wp|Romeo and Juliet|tragedy of the same name}} by William Shakespeare. ==Details== {{Quest details |start = Talk to Romeo in [[Varrock Square]]. |startmap = 3211,3423 |difficulty = Novice |description = [[Romeo]] and [[Juliet]] are desperately in love, but Juliet's father doesn't approve. Help them to find a way to get married and live happily ever after. |length = Short |items = *[[Cadava berries]] (obtainable during the quest) |recommended = Fast travel to [[Varrock]] to start the quest - [[Varrock Teleport]] or [[Chronicle]] or [[Ring of wealth]] to [[Grand Exchange]] or [[Skills necklace]] to [[Cooks' Guild]] |leagueRegion = Misthalin }} ==Walkthrough== {{Map|width=350|height=350|group=questlocs|mtype=pin|align=right |x:3271,y:3367,icon:magentaPin,title:[[Cadava berries]],desc: |x:3195,y:3404,icon:bluePin,title:[[Apothecary]],desc: |x:3211,y:3425,icon:redPin,title:[[Romeo]],desc:quest start |x:3159,y:3426,icon:greenPin,title:[[Juliet]],desc: |x:3254,y:3485,icon:yellowPin,title:[[Father Lawrence]],desc: |caption=Some locations visited during the quest.
'''Legend:'''
{{legend|orangered|caption=Romeo}} {{legend|lawngreen|caption=Juliet '''(upper floor)'''}} {{legend|yellow|caption=Father Lawrence}} {{legend|steelblue|caption=Apothecary}} {{legend|magenta|caption=Cadava berries}} }} ===Starting out=== [[File:Romeo chathead.png|left]] [[Romeo]] can be found in or near [[Varrock Square]]. Speak to him, and he'll ramble about his love for [[Juliet]]. Ask him if you can help, and he'll ask you to talk to her in her mansion. ===Speaking to Juliet=== [[File:Juliet chathead.png|left]] Go and talk to Juliet, located on the upper floor balcony of the [[Leptoc mansion|mansion]] directly west of the [[Varrock west bank]], just outside the western walls of Varrock. She will give you a [[Message (Romeo & Juliet)|letter]] to give to Romeo. Go back to Romeo at Varrock Square, and deliver the letter. If you cannot find Romeo, he may have wandered inside the [[general store]] located south of the square. ===Father Lawrence=== After delivering the letter to Romeo, he will despair upon learning that Juliet's father opposes their marriage. He suggests going to [[Father Lawrence]] for help, who is located in the [[Varrock church]] north-east of the square. After speaking to Father Lawrence, he will suggest that you fake Juliet's death by giving her a [[cadava potion]] to appear dead, so that Romeo can later collect her from the crypt. He will ask you to go to the [[Apothecary]] who will be able to make one for you. ===The potion=== '''''Note:''' You can save some time by having the cadava berries required for the potion in your inventory before speaking to the apothecary. Consider also picking one extra for the quest [[Making Friends with My Arm]]. [[Ironman]] players are recommended to grab some [[redberries]] at the same time as the [[cadava berries]], for use in later quests.'' [[File:Apothecary chathead.png|left|frameless]] The Apothecary can be found in south-western Varrock located west of the [[Varrock Swordshop]], in a building with a purple potion icon. Speak to him about the quest (selecting 'Talk about something else' first) and he will ask you to bring him some [[cadava berries]] to finish the potion. Cadava berries can be picked from several bushes just west of the [[South-east Varrock mine|south-east Varrock mine]]. Return to the Apothecary with the berries and he will give you the [[cadava potion]]. '''Be careful not to drink the potion yourself''', as this will cause the player to black out for a short amount of time. [[File:Romeo & Juliet - Crypt.png|thumb|Romeo and Juliet in the crypt.]]Now, head back to Juliet, and give her the potion. You will now see a cutscene of her "dying", though she really falls into a coma. {{Listen |title = [[Cadava Potion (Romeo & Juliet)|Cadava Potion]] |align = right |filename = Cadava Potion (Romeo & Juliet).ogg |desc = The jingle that plays while Juliet drinks the potion.}} ===To the crypt=== Go back to Romeo, and tell him that he must rescue Juliet from the [[Varrock crypt|crypt]]. He needs someone to accompany him, which ends up being you. You will now see another cutscene of you entering the crypt with Romeo. When he sees Juliet's cousin, [[Phillipa]], he forgets all about Juliet and falls in love with her. {{Listen |title = [[Romeo Falls in Love (Romeo & Juliet)|Romeo Falls in Love]] |align = right |filename = Romeo Falls in Love (Romeo & Juliet).ogg |desc = The jingle that plays when romeo falls in love again.}} '''Congratulations, quest complete!''' ==Rewards== {{Obsolete|The image doesn't include the new quest rewards|update=Quest Month Kick Off, TFA Tweaks & More}} {{Quest rewards|name=Romeo & Juliet|image=[[File:Romeo & Juliet reward scroll.png|centre]]|qp=5|rewards= *An [[Antique lamp (Romeo & Juliet)|antique lamp]] giving 500 XP in a skill of the player's choice. }} ==Required for completing== Completion of Romeo & Juliet is required for the following: *[[Making Friends with My Arm]] *[[Defender of Varrock]] ==Transcript== {{hastranscript|quest}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 3 November 2026 |update = Quest Month Kick Off, TFA Tweaks & More |change = A lamp, giving 500 XP, was added to the quest rewards. }} {{Subject changes |date = 14 January 2026 |update = New Player Improvements Round 2 |change = The quest's journal entry was updated to make it more intuitive. }} {{Subject changes |date = 14 May 2020 |update = Bounty Hunter Feedback Changes |change = All of the free-to-play quest journals have been updated to be more informative. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== *Multiple [[cadava potion]]s can be obtained by dropping the one that's in your inventory and asking for another, though this item has no use outside of the quest. *If you talk to Draul Leptoc, Juliet's father, while carrying the [[cadava potion]], he'll notice it and mention it in his dialogue. *If you talk to Juliet again after the quest, she will seem fed up with Romeo. If you speak to Romeo, he will still be mistaken about Juliet's "death," and will pine after Phillipa. *'Draul Leptoc' is an anagram of 'Lord Capulet', Juliet's father in the original ''Romeo and Juliet''. *Romeo & Juliet was removed from ''RuneScape 3'' on 21 September 2010 and replaced with {{RSL|Gunnar's Ground}}. {{Romeo & Juliet}}

{{External|rs|rsc}} {{Has quick guide}} {{Otheruses|the quest|the shield itself|Shield of Arrav (item)|the book about the shield|Book (Shield of Arrav)}} {{Infobox Quest |name = Shield of Arrav |number = 6 |image = [[File:Shield of Arrav.png|300px]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |series = None |developer = [[Paul Gower]] }} '''Shield of Arrav''' is a quest where the shield of the famous [[Arrav]] of [[Avarrocka]] has been stolen by organised crime syndicates in Varrock. ==Details== {{Quest details |start = Talk to [[Reldo]] in the [[Varrock]] library, located within the northern end of [[Varrock Castle]]. |startmap = 3209,3495 |difficulty = Novice |description = Varrockian literature tells of a valuable shield, stolen long ago from the museum of [[Varrock]], by a gang of professional thieves. See if you can track down this shield and return it to the museum. You will need a friend to help you complete this quest. |length = Short |requirements = * A trustworthy friend or partner. Players can join the official [[chat-channel]] "OSRS SOA" to look for a partner. |items = *Phoenix Gang: 20 [[coins]] *Black Arm Gang: 2 [[Phoenix crossbow]]s (obtained during the quest) |recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|10|link=yes}} |kills = *Black Arm Gang: [[Weaponsmaster]] ''(level 23)'' *Phoenix Gang: [[Jonny the Beard]] ''(level 2)'' |leagueRegion = Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Asgarnia}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest }} ==Walkthrough== During this quest, you must choose one of two gangs to join. In order to fully complete it, you '''must have a partner''', and they must pick the '''opposing''' gang. If your partner has already fully completed the quest, they may only assist if they both picked the opposing gang and chose to obtain additional [[certificate half|certificate halves]] before completing the quest. To find a partner, you may choose to ask in the official [[chat-channel]] ''OSRS SOA''. {{Colour|red|Beware of [[scams#Trust trading scams|scams]], as you will be required to trade with the other player.}} Although the majority of players in the chat-channel offer their services for free, some players also charge [[coins|in-game money]]. It is possible to avoid the trade interface by '''using''' the key and certificate halves obtained during the quest on your partner, allowing the quest to be completed by [[ironmen]] and players with new account [[Account#New account trade restrictions|trade restrictions]]. ===Choosing a gang=== [[File:Reldo chathead.png|left]] Talk to [[Reldo]] in the [[Varrock Palace library]], the northernmost room on the ground floor. Ask him for a quest, and he will suggest you look around for a book called the Shield of Arrav, which may have a quest for you. To find it, search the [[bookcase (Shield of Arrav)|bookcase]] with a blue and white book in the top shelf, located on the east side of the short bookcases in the middle of the room. Read the book, then speak with Reldo again to tell him you have read it. The player will ask him about the whereabouts of the [[Phoenix Gang]] and the [[Black Arm Gang]]. At this stage, you can choose to join either gang. If you wish to join the Phoenix Gang, speak to Baraek, the fur trader in the market. Otherwise, talk to [[Charlie the Tramp]] next to the southern gate of Varrock. When picking your gang, there are a number of considerations: *It is much easier to find Phoenix Gang members via the official chat-channel. *Phoenix Gang is recommended for lower combat levels. *Black Arm Gang is recommended if you do not want to gain combat experience. ===Finishing up=== {{Needed|[[Broken shield]]}} Take your half of the shield to [[Curator Haig Halen]], located in the [[Varrock Museum]]. He will take your half of the shield and give you two copies of [[Half certificate|half the certificate]]. Your partner, who has the other half of the Shield, will receive the other half of the certificate. :'''Note:''' At this stage, players looking to help others in the future may talk to the Curator again to receive additional certificate halves. '''This is only possible before completing the following step'''. Using the [[drop trick]] is not required. There is no practical limit to how many certificate halves you can have. Trade one half of the certificate with your partner for the other half. When you have both certificate halves, use them on the other to obtain a completed [[Certificate (Shield of Arrav)|certificate]]. If completing the quest as an [[Ironman]] you must 'use' the key/certificate on each other. [[File:Shield of Arrav - Certificate.png|centre]] Take the certificate to [[King Roald]] in [[Varrock Palace]] to receive your reward. '''Congratulations, quest complete!''' ==Rewards== {{Obsolete|The image doesn't include the new quest rewards|update=Quest Month Kick Off, TFA Tweaks & More}} {{Quest rewards |name = Shield of Arrav |image = [[File:Shield of Arrav reward scroll.png|centre]] |qp = 1 |rewards = *600 [[coins]] *Ability to claim 5 [[Kudos]] and an [[Antique lamp (Varrock Museum)#Shield of Arrav|Antique lamp]] rewarding 1,000 XP in any skill of at least level 20 from [[Historian Minas]] after completion of the quest (members only) *An [[Antique lamp (Shield of Arrav)|antique lamp]], giving 500 XP in a skill of the player's choice }} ==Required for completing== Completion of Shield of Arrav is required for the following: * [[Heroes' Quest]] * [[Defender of Varrock]] * [[Ethically Acquired Antiquities]] ==Transcript== {{Hastranscript|quest}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 3 November 2026 |update = Quest Month Kick Off, TFA Tweaks & More |change = An antique lamp giving 500 xp was added to the quest rewards. }} {{Subject changes |date = 6 November 2024 |update = The Curse of Arrav & Mobile Anniversary Update |change = Changes were made to the quest with the release of [[The Curse of Arrav]], including but not limited to: * Updated dialogue. * Jonny the Beard is now only attackable when tasked by Straven with doing so, and permanently disappears after the quest for those who killed him. }} {{Subject changes |date = 14 May 2020 |update = Bounty Hunter Feedback Changes |change = All of the free-to-play quest journals have been updated to be more informative. }} {{Subject changes |date = 8 April 2020 |update = Poll 70 Improvements |change = Hints have been added to items that must be traded during Heroes' Quest and Shield of Arrav to clarify how they can be passed to players who cannot trade normally. }} {{Subject changes |date = 13 July 2017 |update = Lizardman Shaman Improvements |change = Corrected some spelling in the Shield of Arrav quest. }} {{Subject changes |date = 23 June 2016 |update = In Other News (23 June 2016) |change = Corrected the capitalisation in a game message when retrieving the book during the Shield of Arrav quest. }} {{Subject changes |date = 29 May 2007 |update = Varrock's New Look |change = The quest was updated with the redesign of Varrock. Before this update, to finish the quest, one of the players would need to give their partner their half of the shield. The person with both halves would then hand them in to the Curator, and get two certificates in return. They would then have to give one of the two certificates to the partner to finish the quest.
After this update, a system that mitigates any element of trust was implemented, where shield halves can be handed in for certificate halves, which can then be exchanged in a single trade. }} {{Subject changes |date = 22 March 2004 |update = RS2 Tweaks and Fixes |change = Fixed an issue where it was possible to restart the quest. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== *Shield of Arrav was one of the 6 quests available during ''RuneScape Classic''{{'}}s launch. *Once a player finishes the quest, they can no longer take any halves of the shield from their storage places. However, players can still acquire the halves of the shield from other players (via trading, drops, or general stores). *In the beginning, a bug allowed the player to join both gangs. Katrine would appear angry at the player, but the player would still be able to enter the Black Arm Gang. The Phoenix gang doorman would also attack the player. *In the early days, entering the Phoenix Gang's headquarters required a separate key. This was later changed, and the key was removed from the game. *The shield is currently on display (display number 24) at the [[Varrock museum|Varrock Museum]] after you speak to the curator on the second floor and tell him how you recovered the shield for the museum. *Before the shield is put onto display in the [[Varrock museum|Varrock Museum]], it mentions "King Roald has offered a 1,200 coins bounty for the reward of the shield and we keep this display case empty in the hopes it will one day be returned." However, King Roald rewards the adventurer only 600 coins for quest completion - half of the advertised offer from the display case. This is because the bounty was split with the other player. *Although it's possible to start the quest with a complete certificate, attempting to turn it in to King Roald yields him saying, "The name on this certificate isn't yours! I can't give you the reward unless you do the quest yourself!" {{Shield of Arrav}}

'''Sheep Shearer''' is one of the six quests available when ''[[RuneScape Classic]]'' first launched. In it, players help [[Fred the Farmer]] shear his [[sheep]].

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Fred the Farmer]] in the house by the [[sheep]] pen north of [[Lumbridge Castle]].
|startmap = 3189,3273
|difficulty = Novice
|description = Fred the Farmer's sheep are getting mighty woolly. He will pay you to shear them.
|length = Very Short
|items = *20 [[balls of wool]] (unnoted)
**[[Shears]] if obtaining [[wool]] to spin into balls of wool (obtained during the quest)
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Asgarnia}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

== Introduction ==
Like [[Cook's Assistant]], this quest is designed to help players explore the starting area of [[Lumbridge]]. New players are encouraged to follow the steps below to explore different parts of the town; however, collecting and spinning the wool are optional, as the balls of wool are tradeable between players and sold in stores. The fastest way to complete the quest is to simply buy 20 balls of wool from the [[Grand Exchange]] and then give them to Fred.{{Map|x=3189|y=3274|r=4|mtype=square|caption=Fred the Farmer's location.|align=right|width=250|height=250}}
==Walkthrough==
[[File:Fred the Farmer chathead.png|left|frameless|width=100x100]]
Speak to [[Fred the Farmer]] at his sheep farm, found slightly north of the [[Lumbridge Castle]]. Ask about a quest, and he will task you with bringing him 20 [[balls of wool]].  

===Obtaining the wool===
{{Needed|recommended=21 free inventory spaces (24 if doing Prince Ali Rescue)}}
[[File:Lumbridge Sheep chathead.png|left|frameless]]
If you did not bring [[shears]], Fred will give you some. Enter the fenced area connected to the east side of the house where the [[sheep]] are.
[[File:Sheep Shearer - Spinning wheel.png|thumb|The [[spinning wheel]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of [[Lumbridge Castle]].]]

'''Note''': Players planning to do the [[free-to-play]] quest [[Prince Ali Rescue]] are advised to shear and spin at least three more [[ball of wool|balls of wool]].

Shear the sheep, either by selecting the "shear" option on the sheep, or right-clicking the shears and selecting "use," then clicking the sheep. After shearing them, the skinny looking sheep will grow back their wool after one minute. If they run away while shearing, just keep trying.

Avoid the [[rams]], which look like regular sheep with horns. They cannot be sheared, and it is easy to accidentally attack them. The pen also contains "[[Sheep (penguins)|The Thing]]", which Fred warned the player about. This is actually two penguins in disguise as a sheep, and attempting to shear it will cause the penguins to squeak and run away from you. It can be identified as the only sheep with the "Talk to" option, and poses no danger during the quest. "The Thing" is later encountered during the [[Cold War]] quest.

Low-level players may consider setting their [[Settings#Controls|attack options]] to "Hidden" for the duration of this quest to avoid entering combat with them by accident.

[[File:Sheep Shearer - Abnormal sheep.png|thumb|The two [[penguin]]s disguised as a [[sheep]].]]

=== Spinning the wool ===
Once you have 20 pieces of [[wool]], they must be spun into balls of wool. Go to the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Lumbridge Castle]], and find the bedroom on the south end of the castle. Inside is a [[spinning wheel]]; click on the wheel with the wool in your [[inventory]] to spin your wool into balls. When they are all spun, go back to Fred the Farmer to finish the quest. If you do not have the space to carry all 20 pieces of wool, you can make smaller deliveries until you reach the required total. Note that Fred will not accept [[Banknote|noted]] balls of wool.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

|image = [[File:Sheep Shearer reward scroll.png|centre]]

*60 [[coins]]
}}

==Trivia==
*This quest, along with [[Cook's Assistant]], [[Doric's Quest]], and [[Imp Catcher]], are the fastest possible quests to complete in the game (provided you are carrying the required items in your [[inventory]] at the start).
* Sheep Shearer is the oldest quest in ''RuneScape'', having existed, albeit incomplete, in ''[[rsw:DeviousMUD|DeviousMUD]]''.

'''Scorpion Catcher''' is a quest in which [[Thormac]], a wizard in the [[Sorcerer's Tower]], has lost three of his scorpions. He tasks you with finding them for him.

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Thormac]] at the top floor of the [[Sorcerer's Tower]], south-east of the [[Ranging Guild]].
|startmap = 2701,3405,plane:3
|difficulty = Intermediate
|description = Thormac the Sorcerer has a hobby involving scorpions. Unfortunately, three of them have escaped and managed to run far away. If you manage to find them all, he may just be able to perform an important service for you.
|length = Short
|requirements = * {{SCP|Prayer|31|link=yes}} {{Boostable|no}} {{Questreqstart|no}}
* Completion of [[Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl]] {{Questreqstart|yes}}
* The ability to run past level 172 [[black demon]]s and level 64 [[poison spider]]s
|items = *[[Dusty key]] (obtainable during the quest) or {{SCP|Agility|70|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}}.
|recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|40|link=yes}}
* [[Anti-dragon shield]] or [[dragonfire shield]] (highly recommended, see the guide for the alternative strategy if they are unavailable)
* [[Antifire potion]] (provides complete immunity to the [[dragonfire]] if used with an anti-dragon or dragonfire shield)
* [[Antipoison]] or [[superantipoison]]
* [[Armour]] and some [[food]]
* [[Stamina potion|Stamina]] or [[energy potion]]s
* Fast travel to several locations
** The Sorcerer's Tower ([[Camelot teleport]], [[Ardougne teleport]] or [[combat bracelet]] to the Ranged Guild)
** Taverley Dungeon ([[Taverley teleport]], [[Falador teleport]] or [[Teleport to House]] if your house is in Taverley)
** Barbarian Outpost ([[games necklace]] or [[Barbarian teleport]])
** Edgeville Monastery ([[combat bracelet]] or [[amulet of glory]] to Edgeville)
|kills = * [[Jailer]] ''(level 47)'' if you need to acquire the [[dusty key]] (alternatively, you can skip this if you have access to the [[Legends Guild Shop of Useful Items]], where the key is sold)
|leagueRegion = <poem>
{{LeagueRegion|Asgarnia}} — location requirement
{{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} — location requirement
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===Scattered scorpions===
{{Map|name=Sorcerer's Tower|x=2702|y=3405|zoom=2|align=right|caption=The location of the Sorcerer's Tower.|width=200|height=200}}
[[File:Thormac chathead.png|left|frameless|80px]]
Talk to [[Thormac]] on the top floor of the [[Sorcerer's Tower]], just south-east of the [[Ranging Guild]] and south of [[Seers' Village]]. He'll tell you that his rare [[Kharid Scorpion]]s have escaped and are currently running loose. He'll give you a [[Scorpion cage]] to catch the scorpions with and suggest you go talk to the Seers that live just to the north.

Speak with any Seer in Seers' Village. He will tell you that the first scorpion is in a secret room with nasty spiders nearby. This is the [[Taverley Dungeon]].

:'''Note''': The secret room is '''only''' accessible once you have spoken to the seer about the location of the first scorpion. Once that is done, you can now catch the three scorpions in any order and may skip talking to the Seer again to find their locations.
{{Clear|left}}
===The first scorpion===
[[File:Kharid Scorpion.png|left|frameless|80px]]
{{Map|2877,9796|name=Kharid Scorpion|width=250|height=250|r=3|mtype=square|mapID=20|caption=The location of the first scorpion, in the [[Taverley Dungeon]].|align=right}}
'''Note''': In the following section, low levelled players are '''highly recommended''' to use an [[anti-dragon shield]] when passing the [[blue dragon]]s, as their dragonfire can inflict up to 50 damage, which the shield reduces by roughly 80%. If used in combination with an [[antifire potion]], the player will gain full immunity. If you have not started [[Dragon Slayer I]] to obtain the shield, read the following sections for a more difficult strategy to avoid the dragonfire. The blue dragons may also be skipped if you have 80 [[Agility]].

Make your way to the [[Taverley Dungeon]]. Once inside, you can skip the following steps if you have 70+ [[Agility]], by either using the [[shortcut]] to the [[blue dragon]]s (70 Agility) or the [[shortcut]] directly to the [[poison spider]]s (80 Agility).

If you cannot use the shortcuts, a [[dusty key]] is required to enter the section of the dungeon that the scorpion is located in. If you do not already have one, follow the track towards the [[Black Knights' Base]] and kill the [[jailer]] located in the eastern area of the base, who will drop a [[jail key]]. Use the jail key on the door of the cell containing [[Velrak the explorer]]. Speak to him; ask if there are any good places to explore, and when he asks you if you want to go further into the dungeon, say yes and he will give you a dusty key. Head to the blue dragons area.

Walk south of the blue dragons, west to pass the [[black demon]]s, and north to the [[poison spider]]s. To the south of the two coffins, there's a small room with a false wall that you can search to open (see the map). If you are unable to open the door, you probably did not speak with the seer about the first scorpion.

Use the [[scorpion cage]] on the small scorpion inside this room to catch it ''(if you try to pick it up, it will sting you for 3 [[Hitpoints]] of damage)''.

'''Strategy without [[anti-dragon shield]]:''' When running past the blue dragons, ensure a [[baby blue dragon]] is fighting you at all times (they do not breathe dragonfire). The dungeon is single-combat, so the more dangerous blue dragons will not attack you while you are in combat. Avoid standing too close to adult dragons, and hop from baby to baby and draw their aggression when passing through. This strategy is not recommended for [[hardcore ironman|hardcore ironmen]] who are not confident they know what they are doing.

{{Map|3058,3488|name=Kharid Scorpion|plane=1|caption=The location of the second scorpion.|width=200|height=200|r=3|mtype=square|align=left}}

===The second scorpion===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Prayer|31}} {{Boostable|no}} to enter the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Edgeville Monastery]]}}
The second scorpion is on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Edgeville Monastery]]. To enter the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} you'll need to speak with [[Abbot Langley]] to join their guild ({{SCP|Prayer|31}}). You do not have to do this again if you have already done it.

Climb the south-east ladder in the Monastery. The scorpion will be either right at the top of the ladder, or in the bedroom directly north of the ladder. Use your cage on it to catch it.

===The third scorpion===
{{Map|2553,3570|name=Kharid Scorpion|caption=The location of the third scorpion.|width=200|height=200|r=3|mtype=square|align=right}}

The third scorpion is in the [[Barbarian Outpost Agility Course]] (requires completion of [[Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl]]), found in the north eastern gated building. The scorpion will be wandering just inside the entrance. Use your cage on it to catch it.

==Walkthrough==
===A mighty hero===
Speak to [[Lucien]] in the [[Flying Horse Inn]] in the north-western corner of [[East Ardougne]]. He wants you to retrieve the [[Staff of Armadyl]] from the deserted [[Temple of Ikov (dungeon)|Temple of Ikov]]. Ask him why he can't get it himself, and he will explain that the guardians of the staff have set up a magical barrier that he is unable to overcome, and give you the [[Pendant of Lucien]], which is required to enter the Chamber of Fear within the dungeon. He wants you to bring the staff to him in his house in [[Edgeville]] once you have found it.

===The Temple of Ikov===
{{Needed|Pendant of Lucien, 20 limpwurt roots, Yew bow or higher '''or''' throwing weapon, light source and knife (only if collecting the boots of lightness)|recommended=Ava's Accumulator, Ranged Armour and [[Protect from Magic]] for ranged style combat}}

In the following section, you will need to briefly reduce your weight to -1kg or less. The easiest method is to use the [[boots of lightness]] found within the dungeon, but any [[weight-reducing clothing]] will work. 

You may wish to bank the limpwurt roots/combat gear and do the dungeon in two trips. You may alternatively bring all of the gear required to complete the quest in one trip, provided you are '''willing to temporarily drop your items''' on the ground and pick them back up again after completing the weightless section (only takes a few seconds).

The temple is located directly south of the [[Ranging Guild]] and west of the [[Sorcerer's Tower]]. Climb down the ladder to enter the [[Temple of Ikov (dungeon)|dungeon]].

===The Boots of Lightness===
[[File:Temple of Ikov - Bridge.png|thumb|220px|The unsteady bridge.]]

If you have not yet collected your boots of lightness and are using it as your weight reducing method, from the entrance run to the west until you come to a set of stairs. You will need your light source with you to descend. Slash the web, pick up '''and equip''' the [[Boots of Lightness]], then return upstairs.

===The Unsteady Bridge===
Head through the northern gate of the room while wearing the pendant. Without wearing the pendant, you will stop and receive the message {{mes|As you reach to open the door a great terror overcomes you!}}

Here you will find an unsteady bridge over lava. To successfully cross this bridge, '''your weight needs to be -1kg or less,''' '''{{Colour|red|or you will fail and take 20 damage!}}'''

If you brought extra items, drop them now until your weight displays -2kg to be safe (you will need to pick up a lever weighing 0.056kg). '''Keep your pendant equipped, or you will be unable to retrieve your items if you messed up the weight and fall!'''

Walk across the bridge and take the [[Lever (Temple of Ikov)|lever]] on the other side.

:'''Note''': If you fell, you made a mistake with the weight and must walk to the south and take the ladder. You will appear just south of [[Hemenster]], walk east to return to the Temple of Ikov.

Pick up any dropped items, then head back to the initial room and place the lever on the lever bracket on the wall south-west of the entrance ladder. '''Pull the lever''' to open the southern room. If you forget to pull the lever and leave the area, it will need to be reobtained.

===The Ice Chamber===

After pulling the lever, the southern gate will be unlocked. Enter it and follow the path to the ice chamber filled with level-61 [[ice spider]]s.

You need to gather enough [[ice arrows]] in this room to battle the [[Fire Warrior of Lesarkus]]. If you've chosen to use throwing weapons, you only need to find at least 1 ice arrow. If using a bow, at least 20 arrows are recommended for low levels, though you can get by with much less if you have a high Ranged level and an [[Ava's device]]. 

To gather [[ice arrows]], you must search the 6 [[Closed chest (Temple of Ikov)|chests]] in this room. Only one will contain arrows at a time. Each time you loot a chest with arrows, you'll obtain 1-5 arrows, and a chest is randomly selected as the next spawn for the arrows. '''After obtaining arrows from a chest, search it again''' as it's possible for it to be randomly selected in succession.

===Fire Warrior of Lesarkus===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Thieving|42}} {{Boostable|yes}} to disable a trap}}
[[File:Temple of Ikov - Fire Warrior of Lesarkus.png|thumb|right|Duelling the [[Fire Warrior of Lesarkus]].]]

When you have enough ice arrows, return to the entrance and again enter the north door with the [[Pendant of Lucien]] equipped. 

:'''Tip:''' You may choose to unequip the pendant after entering if you want to utilise the [[neck slot]] for the following combat section.

Continue north until you see a small alcove with a [[Lever (trap, Temple of Ikov)|lever]] in it. Right-click the lever to ''Search for traps'' ({{SCP|Thieving|42}}), then pull it. '''{{Color|red|If you don't search the lever first, you will fall into a pit of spikes and take 20 damage.}}'''

The door at the end of the western passage will now be unlocked. Open it to enter a room with a summoning mark in the middle of it. Attempt to open the door to the north, and you'll be stopped by the [[Fire Warrior of Lesarkus]].

To continue you must defeat the Fire Warrior. He is intended to only take damage from ice arrows, however using throwing weapons with at least 1 ice arrow equipped will circumvent this without using up the arrows. After interrupting you, he will not attack until you either attack him first or talk to him. He uses solely magic, so [[Protect from Magic]] comes in handy. Using [[Ava's accumulator]] will assist you in not running out of arrows, though you can also pick up fallen arrows during the fight. If you take too long to defeat him or walk too far from the room, he will disappear and you will need to start the fight over.

:'''Note''': If you use the wrong weapon or run out of ice arrows, he will stop the fight and boast that your weapons do nothing, but will not regenerate health if you resume the fight.

After defeating him, proceed through the north door. You'll find [[Winelda]] the witch standing near a stream of lava. She will teleport you across if you hand her 20 unnoted limpwurt roots, '''all given at once'''.

:'''Note''': In case you have to re-enter the room, you do not need to fight the Fire Warrior again or bring the witch more limpwurt roots.

Pass the skeletons until you reach a room behind a brick wall. ''Push'' the wall to enter it.

:'''Tip:''' Before entering consider picking up the [[shiny key]] found past the level 82 [[Lesser demon]]s further along the corridor, which will allow you to access a shortcut to [[McGrubor's Wood]] through a ladder next to the skeletons. This may be useful if you want to return to fight the monsters in this part of the dungeon after the quest.

===Picking a side===
At this stage you must decide whether to take the staff for Lucien, resulting in combat with a level 43 [[Guardian of Armadyl]], or whether to side with the [[Guardians of Armadyl]], who will ask you to defeat a level 14 [[Lucien]]. Your choice will have a minor impact on the [[While Guthix Sleeps]] quest dialogue. If you choose to side with Lucien and want to obtain the [[Pendant of Armadyl]] again after the quest (used as protection for the [[God Wars Dungeon]]), you will need to kill the guardians rather than talk to them. Otherwise, the rewards remain the same for both paths.

===Side with the Guardians of Armadyl===
[[File:Temple of Ikov - Lucien mind trick.gif|thumb|upright|200px|Lucien will use a mind trick on players who aren't wearing the pendant of Armadyl.]]
{{Color|red|Warning:}} If you don't unequip your pendant or choose the wrong dialogue option, the guardian will attack you.

Unequip your [[Pendant of Lucien]] and talk to the Guardian. Tell them that you seek the [[Staff of Armadyl]] for [[Lucien]], then explain that Lucien offered a grand reward for it. The Guardian will offer to cleanse you to save your soul as a result of working for that 'spawn of evil'. Tell them it's time for "your yearly bath", and they will cleanse you with holy water. They will explain that Lucien is an undead necromancer that raised an army of the undead against Varrock a generation ago. Offer to help defeat him, and they will give you the [[Armadyl pendant]], which must be worn to defeat him. {{Chat option|1I seek the Staff of Armadyl.|1Lucien will give me a grand reward for it!|3You're right, it's time for my yearly bath.|1Ok! I'll help!}}

Head towards Lucien's house which is between [[Edgeville]] and the [[Grand Exchange]]. Defeat him (level 14) while wearing the Armadyl pendant.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

===Side with Lucien===
[[File:Temple of Ikov - Staff of Armadyl.png|thumb|left|200px|The [[Staff of Armadyl]] lying on a table.]]
You may ignore the conversation with the Guardians. Try to take the [[Staff of Armadyl]] on the table in the north-west room. You will be attacked by a [[Guardian of Armadyl]] (Level 43). Defeat them, and take the staff.

Head towards Lucien's house which is between [[Edgeville]] and the [[Grand Exchange]]. Hand him the staff to complete your quest.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
{{Clear}}

The target of the quest is to herd the sick sheep, kill them and dispose of their remains to prevent the plague from spreading to the town. ==Walkthrough==
===A threat to public health and safety===
{{Needed|100 [[coins]]}}
{{Map|x=2617|y=3299|r=3|mtype=square|align=right|caption=The quest's start point.|width=250|height=250}}

Speak to [[Councillor Halgrive]] located in [[East Ardougne]] in the graveyard directly south of the church.

He is concerned about [[Sick-looking sheep|plagued sheep]] located near East Ardougne that escaped from a local farm, causing a threat to the health and safety for the public. He is looking for someone to herd the sheep, kill them quickly and cleanly, and dispose the remains in a special [[incinerator (Sheep Herder)|incinerator]] set up by [[Farmer Brumty]].

Agree to help do the job. He will happily thank you and mention you need a [[plague suit]] while herding the sheep. He will tell you to pick up the plague suit from [[Doctor Orbon]] and hand you some poisoned [[sheep feed]].

Head inside the church and talk to Doctor Orbon. After explaining you need protective clothing to dispose the escaped infected sheep, he will sell his last suit for 100 [[coins]] so he can afford a replacement for himself. Agree to pay for the suit, and you should receive a plague jacket and plague trousers. Pray with missing [[Prayer points]] at the [[altar]] to complete an easy task in the [[Ardougne diary]].

===Herding the sheep===
{{Needed|[[Plague jacket]], [[plague trousers]]}}
{{Map|align=right|mtype=pin|caption=Location of the sheep.
|2609,3389,title:Location of the yellow sheep,icon:yellowPin,desc:
|2620,3368,title:Location of the green sheep,icon:greenPin,desc:
|2608,3346,title:Location of the red sheep,icon:redPin,desc:
|2569,3383,title:Location of the blue sheep,icon:bluePin,desc:
}}
Head to the fenced in enclosure located north-west of the north bank in [[East Ardougne]]. With your [[plague suit]] equipped, enter the gate on the west side of the enclosure. Head towards the incinerator where you will find a [[cattleprod]] lying on the ground a few steps south of the incinerator. Pick it up. 

Leave the fenced in enclosure using the west gate. You can begin to dispose of the sheep by equipping the cattleprod and using it to direct the sheep into the fenced in enclosure using the west gate. The sheep will be prodded in the direction of which you are facing. The sheep can return back to their initial locations if you wait too long to prod. '''You only need one of each colour (in any order)''', and you can finish one sheep at a time.

Note: You can have a friend join you and body block the sheep, preventing them from going farther than desired and also prevent them from going back to their original location. 

*Red sheep are located north of the north bank in East Ardougne.
*Green sheep are north-east of the red sheep, directly north of a fenced in area with chopped and fallen trees.
*Blue sheep are located north-west of the fenced in enclosure with the incinerator, nearby a small camp with [[Warrior (Thieving)|warriors]]. Do not go too far, as there are also aggressive level 42 [[moss giant]]s nearby.
*Yellow sheep are located south of the [[Fishing Guild]].

Note: If a sheep goes '''''BAAAAA!''''' (uppercase letters), it will be prodded in the direction you direct them towards. If a sheep goes '''''Baa''''', it will return to its initial location. When directing them to the fenced in pen with the incinerator located, it is better to spam click the sheep so that it does not walk back. If the sheep gets stuck against a corner or wall, prod them again, this will cause them to move towards an open tile. Make sure you prod the sheep one last time to get it IN the pen when you are close.
[[File:Sheep Herder - Sheep.png|thumb|All four sheep in the pen.]]

===Killing the plagued sheep===
{{Needed|[[Plague jacket]], [[plague trousers]], [[Sheep feed|poisoned sheep food]]}}

Once you have directed them to the gate of the incinerator, the sheep will automatically go inside the gate. Use the [[Sheep feed|poisoned sheep food]] to kill each sheep. Collect their bones and use them on the incinerator to burn the remains.

Return to [[Councillor Halgrive]] and tell him you disposed of the four sheep. He will reimburse you the 100 [[coins]] you spent for the protective clothing in addition to 3,000 coins as recognition of your service.

'''Congratulations! Quest completed!'''

[[File:Sea Slug - Drying damp sticks.png|thumb|left|130px|Using the glass to dry the sticks.]]
[[File:Sea Slug - Rescuing Kennith.png|thumb|200px|Using the crane to save Kennith.]]
Pick up some [[damp sticks]] close to the ladder in the north-east corner of the platform, then climb up the ladder. Upstairs, in a room on the west side, past the crane, you will find [[Kennith]]. He will tell you that his father tried to leave days ago, but the fishermen stopped him from doing so. He will ask you to find his father, [[Kent]] and help him.

Go back to [[Holgart]] and talk to him. He will take you to a deserted island, where you will find Kennith's father stranded. Talk to Kent and he will tell you his story. Then ask Holgart to take you back to the platform. Talk to [[Bailey]] to find out the slugs' weakness - they are afraid of heat. He will give you an [[unlit torch]], which he cannot light himself as it is too damp. Use the [[broken glass]] on the [[damp sticks]], which are found near the ladder to [[Dry sticks|dry them]], then rub them together to '''light the torch''' ({{SCP|Firemaking|30}}). If you do not light it now, you will be damaged by a fisherman when going upstairs.

Climb up the ladder again (on the north-east of the platform), go into the room, and talk to [[Kennith]]. From outside the room, kick the [[badly repaired wall]] to make an opening, then use your lit torch on any fisherman or sea slugs nearby and then talk to Kennith again. Rotate the [[crane (Sea Slug)|crane]] to save him, shown in a cut scene. Talk to [[Holgart]] to return to shore. Finish the quest by talking to [[Caroline]].

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

===The study group===
{{Needed|A [[cup of tea]]}}
There are three students in the [[Digsite]] who can help you with the exam answers, but they each have a lost item they want retrieved first. To save time, gather these items before visting the students.

===Teddy===
[[File:Student (Teddy) chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Head north of the Exam centre until you come upon two wooden walkways. Follow the eastern walkway to the top of the small hill and search the easternmost [[Bush (The Dig Site)|bush]] by the [[Large urn|large blue urn]] to find the missing [[teddy bear]]. 
{{Clear|left}}
===Special cup===
[[File:Student (Special cup) chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Enter the tent at the end of the walkway and pick up the [[panning tray]] from the table. Use the [[cup of tea]] on the nearby [[panning guide]] and he will thank you and allow you to pan in the river to the east. Using the [[panning point]]s, pan in the river until you get the [[special cup]]. You may also receive an [[uncut opal]], keep it for later in the quest.
{{Clear|left}}

===Animal skull===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Thieving|25}} {{Boostable|yes}} to pickpocket a [[Digsite workman]]}}
[[File:Student (Animal skull) chathead.png|left|frameless]]

"Steal-from" nearby [[Digsite workman|Digsite workmen]] until {{Mes|You steal an animal skull}} appears. If you obtain a [[specimen brush]] whilst stealing from the workmen, keep it as you'll need it later in the quest.

{{Clear|left}}

===Learning the answers===
Once you have all three lost items, return them to each student (you will need to talk to each person twice).

The [[Student#Animal skull|first student]] who lost the animal skull has blonde hair and is wearing a green shirt, north of the tent.

Further north-east is the [[Student#Special cup|second student]] who lost his special cup, wearing an orange shirt, with short black hair and darker skin.

The [[Student#Teddy|female student]] who lost their teddy bear is further north-west, wearing all purple with blonde hair.

===Retaking the exams===
{{Needed|An [[uncut opal|opal]] (cut or uncut).}}

'''Note''': If the correct answer is not present in the selection given, you must have missed talking to a student. Check the quest log to find out which one, speak to them, and then try again.
====Level 1====
[[File:The Dig Site - Level 1 certificate.png|thumb|right|220px|The first certificate.]]
After helping out all three students, return to the [[Exam Centre]] and speak to an Examiner. Speak to her to retake the exam. To pass it, use the answers that the students gave you:
#Can you tell me what Earth Sciences is? - '''The study of the earth, its contents and history.'''
#Can you tell me which people are allowed to use the digsite? - '''All that have passed the appropriate Earth Sciences exam.'''
#Can you tell me the proper safety points when working on a digsite? - '''Gloves and boots to be worn at all times; proper tools must be used.'''

If done correctly, players will receive a [[Level 1 certificate]] and a [[trowel]].

====Level 2====
To pass the level 2 test, speak to the three students again to get the answers and return to the Examiner. The questions and answers are:
#Can you tell me how we transport samples? - '''Samples taken in rough form; kept only in sealed containers.'''
#What is the proper way to handle finds? - '''Finds must be carefully handled, and gloves worn.'''
#Can you tell me the proper use for a rock pick? - '''Always handle with care; strike cleanly on its cleaving point.'''

Upon passing, players receive a [[Level 2 certificate]].

====Level 3====
To pass the level 3 test, you need to speak to the three students again to obtain the answers. '''However''', the female student will ask for an [[uncut opal]] or [[opal]] this time. If you still need one, pan in the river until you obtain it. Talk to her twice, she will first request the opal, then give it to her in the second conversation. Return to the examiner and take the last test:

#Can you tell me how we prepare samples? - '''Samples cleaned, and carried only in specimen jars.'''
#What is the proper way to use a specimen brush? - '''Brush carefully and slowly using short strokes.'''
#Can you describe the technique for handling bones? - '''Handle bones very carefully and keep them away from other samples.'''

Upon passing, players receive a [[Level 3 certificate]] and permission to dig in all levels. You may choose to keep the certificate to later exchange with the [[Museum Curator]] for a [[chocolate cake]] or [[fruit blast]], which may be used for other quests like [[Desert Treasure I]] and [[Recipe for Disaster]].

===Ancient discovery===
{{Needed|A [[trowel]], a [[specimen brush]], and a [[specimen jar]].|skills={{SCP|Thieving|25}} {{Boostable|yes}} to pickpocket a [[Digsite workman]]}}
[[File:Ancient talisman detail.png|left|85px]]
Grab a [[specimen jar]] from the [[cupboard (specimen jar)|cupboard]] on the south wall inside the [[Exam Centre]]. If there is no search option, speak to [[Terry Balando]] about the tools first. Head back to the Digsite and pickpocket a [[Digsite workman]] ({{SCP|Thieving|25}}) until you get a [[specimen brush]] if you didn't get one earlier.

Head to a dig site marked by a level 3 sign, either the south-westernmost dig site or the northernmost dig site (see map above). Use your [[trowel]] on the soil until you find an [[ancient talisman]]. '''This often takes many tries and can easily take several minutes to find.''' {{Mes|You find a strange talisman}} will appear in a dialogue box when found.

Bring the talisman to [[Terry Balando]] in the Exam Centre, who identifies it as a talisman of [[Zaros]], a pagan god little is known of. As a reward he will allow you to use the private dig shafts, giving you an [[invitation letter]] to show a [[Digsite workman]] as proof.

There are two [[Winch|winches]] in the [[Digsite]] (see map above). Use your [[Invitation letter]] on a [[Digsite workman]] ('''not''' the 'Dig site workman' which lacks a pickpocket option) that's working near a winch, and then use a [[rope]] on the west winch to gain access to the sublevels of the Digsite.

Climb down the rope by operating the winch ({{SCP|Agility|10}}). Grab an [[arcenia root]] just north of the rope, then head south-east where there are bricks blocking the way. "Search" the bricks, and the player will muse about asking someone to help move them.

Return to the surface and head towards the north-east winch. Use another rope and go down, there you will find [[Doug Deeping]]. Speak to him and ask him how you can move a large pile of rocks. He will give you a [[chest key (Digsite)|chest key]].

{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Herblore|10}} {{Boostable|yes}} to create a [[chemical compound]]}}
[[File:Chemical compound detail.png|left|frameless|50px]]

Use the [[chest key (Digsite)|chest key]] on the [[chest (Chemical powder)|chest]] in the tent where you got your [[panning tray]] to get [[chemical powder]]. Use your [[trowel]] on the centre barrel just west of the tent to open it, then use a [[vial]] on it to fill it with an [[unidentified liquid]]. '''{{Color|red|Do not drop it}} or you will take 25 non-fatal damage and must re-retrieve the ingredients.'''

If you didn't bring [[charcoal]], you may search the [[specimen tray]] north of the tent with a [[specimen jar]] in your inventory until you find some.

{{Checklist|
*Use the [[chemical powder]] on [[Terry Balando]] in the [[Exam Centre]] to learn that it's [[ammonium nitrate]], then '''use''' ({{Color|red|do not empty/drop}}) the [[unidentified liquid]] on him to learn that it's [[nitroglycerin]].
*Use the ammonium nitrate on the nitroglycerin to make [[mixed chemicals]] ({{SCP|Herblore|6}}).
*Grind your charcoal with a [[pestle and mortar]] to get [[ground charcoal]].
*Use the ground charcoal on the mixed chemicals ({{SCP|Herblore|8}}).
*Use the arcenia root on the mixed chemicals to create a [[chemical compound]]  ({{SCP|Herblore|10}}).

{{Color|red|Warning:}} If you drop the [[chemical compound]] now, you will take 65 non-fatal damage.

[[File:The Dig Site - Senntisten.png|thumb|220px|left|The Zarosian altar found after blowing up the rocks.]]
Once you have the chemical compound, go down the western winch to use the [[chemical compound]] on the bricks (not the rocks), and then use a [[tinderbox]] on the bricks. Your character will run away as the bricks explode, clearing the path. Pick up the [[Stone tablet (The Dig Site)|stone tablet]] in the room, avoiding the level 22 [[Skeleton]]s if below 45 [[Combat Level]]. 

Bring the tablet to Terry Balando, who remarks that the tablet shows that the followers of Saradomin must have tried to cover up the evidence of the [[Zaros]] altar when building [[Varrock]]. He gives you two [[gold bars]] as a reward.

==Introduction==
Before starting any of the sections, you will have to talk to [[Ali Morrisane]] in Al Kharid to discuss each business expansion.

By asking what's in it for you, you will also unlock a discount on his [[magic carpet]] network: 100 coins per trip (down from 200), or 75 coins (down from 100) with the [[Ring of Charos(a)]]. If you do not do this now, you will still unlock the discount at the end of the miniquest.

==Runes==
Ali Morrisane will tell you to talk to [[Aubury]] in [[Varrock]] about a rune deal. Go to Aubury and speak to him about Ali's business proposal, then return to Ali.

Ask to see Ali's rune stock, and he will complain that there is an odd lock mechanism on the caskets of runes and that he is unable to open them. There are 2 caskets: Small casket and large casket. For both caskets, players get these three options:

*'''Force Box:''' higher chances of success with higher [[Strength]] levels, provides Strength experience
*'''Pick Lock:''' higher chances of success with higher [[Thieving]] levels, provides Thieving experience
*'''Examine Lock:''' players will see a sudoku puzzle with runes substituting the numbers

The small casket contains elemental runes and is easier to open compared to the large casket. Players may choose any of the 3 options on the small casket.

The large casket contains non-elemental runes and can only be opened via the puzzle – choose "Examine Lock". It cannot be successfully opened by forcing or picking the lock; attempting to do so always fails. You can either solve the sudoku puzzle yourself or use a sudoku solver ("runedoku solver"). The main objective is to line up the runes so that no runes are repeated in any row, line, or 3x3 grid.
[[File:Rogue Trader - Sudoku.png|thumb|The Sudoku screen.]]
[[File:Rogue Trader - Completed Sudoku.png|thumb|A completed Sudoku screen.]]

Opening the caskets will allow you to purchase runes of the respective type from [[Ali Morrisane|Ali]]. Right after solving the puzzle, you will have the options of either choosing to buy all the runes for a specified discounted price or to see what the runes are first. If you decide to see the runes first, you lose a small portion of your discount (about a 6-10% cost difference). Doing each runedoku puzzle also unlocks [[Ali's Discount Wares.#Runes|Ali's standard rune stock]] for each type, which is slightly more expensive than the cost of the runes in the interface seen after opening the runedoku. You may also continue to do runedoku puzzles for slightly cheaper limited selections of runes.

====Success chances====
{{DropLogProject|jagex=yes|success=yes}}

The chance to successfully force the lock of a small casket depends on both your Strength and Agility levels - you need to pass both [[stat_random|skilling success rolls]] to force the lock. Failing to force the lock will also drain your Strength and Agility levels by 0-3 levels (1/4 chance each, the same amount from both). Successfully forcing the lock gives 2.5 Strength and 2.5 Agility experience.

The chance to successfully pick the lock of a small casket depends on your Thieving level and if you are carrying a [[lockpick]] - notably, failing to unlock the casket has a 1/5 chance to break a lockpick; breaking a lockpick gives 0.5 Thieving experience. Failing to pick the lock will also drain your Thieving level by 0–3 levels (1/4 chance each). Successfully picking the lock gives 5 Thieving experience.

{{Skilling success chart|label=Breaking open a small casket
|label1=Forcing the lock part 1 - Strength|low1=70|high1=170|req1=1|image1=Strength.png
|label2=Forcing the lock part 2 - Agility|low2=120|high2=255|req2=1|image2=Agility.png
|label3=Picking the lock|low3=70|high3=170|req3=1|image3=Thieving.png
|label4=Picking the lock with a lockpick|low4=70|high4=240|req4=1|image4=Lockpick.png
}}

Large caskets can also be attempted to be picked open with a lockpick, but it always fails and drains levels like with the small casket and has a chance of the lockpick breaking, also granting 0.5 Thieving experience.

===Strategy===
A trick that works with the smaller rune caskets is to position the runes as shown.

:1 2 3 4
:4 3 2 1
:3 4 1 2
:2 1 4 3

The placement of the starting runes varies, but the pattern is always the same. This pattern can always be performed regardless of starting placement.

==Blackjacks==
Head south to the town of [[Pollnivneach]] and talk to the [[Blackjack seller]] who is outside, just south of [[Ali the Kebab seller]] (named '''Isma'il the Kebab seller''' after [[The Feud]]). Go through the conversation with him, and choose either 'cunning plan' option for defensive blackjacks or ask him to knock you out for offensive blackjacks.

If choosing the cunning plan, talk to the urchin and pay him 100 coins to make him help you convince the Blackjack salesman that he needs to produce some different equipment. There will be a short cutscene. After that cutscene ends, talk to the Blackjack seller again.

If choosing to get knocked out, you will have to successfully take two hits from the blackjack seller without getting knocked out. Simply go through the dialogue. If you get knocked out, you will take 3 damage and have to go through the dialogue again.

Once you return to Al Kharid, Ali Morrisane will now stock [[Ali's Discount Wares.#Blackjacks|offensive or defensive blackjacks]]. He will also ask that you return to Pollnivneach and ask the Blackjack seller to expand his wares further. This is optional and will switch Ali Morrisane's inventory between offensive and defensive blackjacks.

==Clothes==
This section requires the player to have started [[Icthlarin's Little Helper]] for access to Sophanem. Completing the quest will also unlock a carpet ride there from south Pollnivneach.

Talk to [[Siamun]] in the building east of the silk stall with the spinning wheel in [[Sophanem]].

Siamun is a rude, gruff character who wants either three dyes or three hides '''of the same animal'''. Siamun will accept [[cow hide|cowhide]], [[grey wolf fur]], [[snakeskin]] (not un-tanned [[snake hide]]), [[bear fur]], or [[wool]] (not [[balls of wool]]). He will not accept bank notes. Giving him dyes will cause Morrisane to stock [[Menaphite clothing]] and giving the hides will stock [[Desert outfit]]. Both sets are cosmetic variants of [[Desert clothing]] with identical stats.

Once you have given Siamun the items, he will begin shipping clothing, unlocking the [[Ali's Discount Wares.#Clothing|clothing section of Ali's store]].

If you talk to [[Ali Morrisane]] back in Al Kharid, he will ask that you return to [[Sophanem]] and ask [[Siamun]] to make additional clothing. This is optional and will switch Morrisane's inventory between the two outfits.

==Completion!==
After completing all three tasks (rune boxes, blackjacks, and clothes), you will have unlocked full access to [[Ali's Discount Wares.]]

If you did not get the magic carpet network discount earlier, Ali will also give it to you now as a token of his gratitude.

==Post-errand task==
After helping [[Ali Morrisane]] with runes, blackjacks and clothing, and completing [[Prince Ali Rescue]], you may engage in optional, additional dialogue with any shop owner within [[Al Kharid]], asking about their opinion of Ali. They will all claim that he is a shifty man, and that he's brought four men from the south to set up business, and has sent them to all the shop owners around Al Kharid to threaten them if they do not work for Ali Morrisane.

These four men are [[Ali the Farmer]], [[Ali the Guard]], [[Ali the Smith]] and [[Ali the Tailor]], who appear south of Ali Morrisane's stall immediately after you complete his three errands. Speak to any of them, saying that you have heard that they work for Ali Morrisane. They will say that he has assisted them in setting up shop in exchange for a cut of their profits.

Speak to Ali Morrisane. Tell him that you have heard of his plans of expanding business, and that his men are threatening the other shopkeepers. He will respond by expressing his regret over the situation, explaining that his men are simply overenthusiastic. He then reveals that his ultimate goal is to take control of all the shops in Al Kharid to put an end to these issues.

==Walkthrough==
{{Map:Tai Bwo Wannai Geo}}<!-- This map does not use the regular template as it cannot draw text labels; the GeoJSON used as an alternative is rather bloated, and is therefore placed in mapspace and transcluded here-->
===Introduction (visiting Timfraku)===
{{Needed|A [[knife]], [[Karamjan rum]] (or 30 coins), and a [[banana]].|recommended=[[Amulet of glory]], [[Antipoison]]}}

Teleport to the [[Musa Point]] banana plantation with your [[amulet of glory]] and pick a banana if you do not already have one. Then, go south to the [[Karamja Wines, Spirits, and Beers|Karamja Spirits Bar]] and purchase [[Karamjan rum|Karamja Rum]]. Slice the [[banana]] using your knife (or a spear) and add the [[sliced banana]] to your rum, making sure not to accidentally eat the sliced banana. Make sure you combine the sliced banana with the rum '''before''' you leave the island, or the rum will break. The rum combined with sliced banana will be necessary in a later part of the quest.

After obtaining the Karamjan rum, travel south to [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] (fairy ring {{Fairycode|CKR}}) and talk with [[Timfraku]] upstairs in the north-west house with a quest [[icon]] above it. Talk with him, and say that [[Trufitus]] sent you. Talk to him again, and when he thanks you for what you have done so far, pick the option "So far??" and he will ask you to gather his sons, [[Tamayu]], [[Tiadeche]], and [[Tinsay]], in the village. {{Colour|Red|Warning}}: The [[Tribesmen]] in and around Tai Bwo Wannai are aggressive to players level 64 and under and deal very high poison damage, easily killing unprepared low-level players. The general store north of Tai Bwo Wannai sells [[antipoison]]s if you forgot to bring some.

:'''''Optional:''''' To avoid accidentally banking/losing the [[Karamjan rum (sliced banana)]], you can visit Tinsay at [[Cairn Isle]] (near fairy ring {{Fairycode|CKR}}) and give it to him. This will fulfil the first of three requests he makes later on.
{{clear|right}}
===Tamayu===
{{Needed|A [[small fishing net]], a [[pestle and mortar]] or 6 gold, an [[Agility potion|Agility potion(4)]] and one of any of the following spears: [[iron spear]], [[steel spear]], [[mithril spear]], [[adamant spear]], [[rune spear]], or [[dragon spear]]. Tamayu will accept any spear given to him, but only the ones listed will work for completing the quest|recommended=[[Logs]] (or an axe to chop them), a [[tinderbox]], and a [[raw karambwan]] (one is obtainable later in the quest), [[Brimhaven teleport|Brimhaven Teleport]].|skills={{SCP|Fishing|5}} {{Boostable|yes}} to catch [[raw karambwanji]]}}

[[File:Meeting Tamayu.png|thumb|Tamayu must slay the Shaikahan before he returns to the village.]]
You can find [[Tamayu]] south-east of Tai Bwo Wannai Village at the mine. He will return to Tai Bwo Wannai only once he has killed [[The Shaikahan]]. Talk to him twice; ask him when he will succeed and offer to join him on his next hunt. During a [[cutscene]] Tamayu will fail to defeat The Shaikahan. He will claim that he is overpowered by its strength, regenerating health, and agility.

'''Do not give your [[spear]] to Tamayu yet. You must poison the spear with karambwan paste, obtained later in the quest, before giving it to Tamayu.''' Go to the [[Holy Lake]] south-west of Tamayu and net-fish for at least 22 [[raw karambwanji]] ({{SCP|Fishing|5}}). (It's recommended to have a few spares or keep the net for later if your [[Cooking]] level is low.) (They are different from [[Karambwan]] and stack like other forms of bait.) If you still need logs, there are some trees that can be cut to the south-west of this pond near the Hunter icon on the minimap.

Now travel north. If you don't have a [[Pestle and mortar]], you can buy one at [[Jiminua's Jungle Store]] (general store icon) north-west of the village. Then continue and talk to [[Lubufu]] (near the POH portal, [[Brimhaven teleport|Brimhaven Teleport]] is useful here) by the fishing [[icon]] on the south-eastern shore of [[Brimhaven]].

[[File:Tai Bwo Wannai Trio Lubufu.png|thumb|Lubufu teaching you the secrets to catching karambwan.]]
Select to "Talk about him..." and ask him how old he is. Then offer to help him collect bait, and then say that he sounds like he could do with the help. He will then tell you to catch 20 karambwanji. Give him the karambwanji and ask him what he uses to catch karambwan, followed by what he does with them, and he will ask you if you want to become his apprentice (you will need to select all options, not just the two listed here). He will then give you a [[karambwan vessel]] and the information that it must be filled with karambwanji as bait. '''You can now catch [[raw karambwan]] with 65 fishing, you will also receive 1500 [[Fishing]] experience'''. If your character goes idle after a couple seconds of fishing, you need to fish at the fishing spots next to Tiadeche in the north east of Karamja. It is recommended you collect more vessels at this stage, one for [[Tiadeche]], one for [[Tinsay]] and one for yourself. You can obtain more by dropping the one in your inventory and then asking [[Lubufu]] for another.

Once you have obtained as many as you wish use a [[raw karambwanji]] on one of these vessels.

See below on how to complete the Tamayu part of this quest.
[[File:Tai Bwo Wannai Trio - Tiadeche catches a karambwan.png|thumb|Tiadeche catches a karambwan.]]

===Tiadeche===
{{Needed|A [[Karambwan vessel]], an agility potion (4), and a [[Raw karambwanji]]. Logs and Tinderbox, and a [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] method to kill a [[Monkey]] if you want to save time.}}

Next, go to the north-east corner of the Karamja jungle (fairy ring {{Fairycode|DKP}}) to seek out [[Tiadeche]]. Once found, talk to him. He says he will go back to Tai Bwo Wannai after you teach him how to catch [[Karambwan]]. Give him your '''full''' [[Karambwan vessel]] '''(use your karambwanji on the vessel first, then use the full vessel on Tiadeche)''' and he will subsequently give you a [[Raw karambwan]]. He will also ask you to bring a Karambwan vessel to his brother [[Tinsay]] to request that he study the vessel's design, so the tribe can craft additional vessels. (He will not give you the vessel back; you will have to go get another from Lubufu if you did not already obtain additional vessels earlier.)

While you are here you can grab the nearby [[Seaweed]] that spawns on the beach as you will need it later on.

Once you have the raw karambwan, cook it to obtain a [[poison karambwan]]. If you are an Ironman and burn the [[Karambwan]], you will need to catch another (requires 65 [[Fishing]]). Consider using the [[Hosidius Kitchen]] or some other [[Cooking#Temporary boosts|Cooking boosts]] to minimise the risk of burning it.

Use the [[pestle and mortar]] on the [[Poison karambwan]] to produce [[Karambwan paste]]. Then, use the paste on the [[spear]] to create a karambwan poisoned spear. If you eat the [[Poison karambwan]] you will take up to 5 damage, so right-click on it and select the "use" option, or simply use the pestle and mortar to avoid doing so.

Now, head back to [[Tamayu]] by running south. If you didn't purchase the [[Jogre bones]], kill a [[Jogre]] on the way and pick up the bones. If you don't have a spear, you can continue killing jogres until they drop an [[iron spear]]. Cross the agility shortcut, then run west to the mine.

[[File:Tai Bwo Wannai Trio - The Shaikahan.png|thumb|Tamayu fights the Shaikahan.]]
{{Listen
|title = [[Tamayu Slays the Shaikahan (Tai Bwo Wannai Trio)|Tamayu Slays the Shaikahan]]
|align = right
|filename = Tamayu Slays the Shaikahan (Tai Bwo Wannai Trio).ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays when Tamayu defeats the Shaikahan.}}
Once you have returned to Tamayu, use the newly poisoned spear and your [[Agility potion|Agility potion(4)]] on him (being careful not to drink the potion). While it can be given over multiple potions, he needs 4 doses total. You can now join Tamayu on his hunt and a short [[cutscene]] will play showing Tamayu being successful on his hunt. Once he has slain [[The Shaikahan]] he will promise to return to the village once you've talked with his brothers and father.

To save some time helping [[Tinsay]], kill a nearby [[monkey]] (with [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]], or with a [[halberd]] from one square away) and use its [[Monkey corpse|corpse]] on [[Tamayu]]. He will ask you if you'd like him to skin it, returning the [[monkey bones]] and [[Monkey skin|skin]] (you only need to save the skin).

===Tinsay===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Agility|15}} {{Boostable|yes}} to climb the [[rock slide (Cairn Isle)|rock slide]] to [[Cairn Isle]]}}
Now head to [[Cairn Isle]] in order to talk to [[Tinsay]]. He is located up the rockslide ({{SCP|Agility|15}}) and across the bridge. He'll tell you that he's trying to repair the [[Tribal Statue]] in the village. He has lost his sanity recently due to some sort of accident with a [[Jogre]]. He asks for three special local items.

====Banana rum (if not done beforehand)====
{{Needed|A [[banana]], [[Karamjan rum]], and a [[knife]]. Note that the knife is not strictly required. A slashing weapon seems to work as well.}}

The first thing he'll ask you to get him is a bottle of banana-flavoured rum. Head to [[Musa Point]], and buy a bottle of [[Karamjan rum]] from the liquor store there. Then, go into the [[general store]], take the banana and knife off the table and use the knife with the banana to slice it. Add these [[Sliced banana|slices]] to the rum and give it to Tinsay (be careful not to eat the slices).

Do not use a whole banana on the rum without slicing it. It will create a joke item, [[Karamjan rum (banana)]]. If done so you will need to get another bottle of [[Karamjan rum]] to try again.

====Seaweed sandwich====
{{Needed|[[Seaweed]], and a [[monkey skin]]  or a [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] method to kill a monkey.}}

Next Tinsay wants you to bring him a [[Seaweed sandwich]]. If you do not already have the items cross back over the bridge to collect [[Seaweed]] from the beach and equip your [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] gear (or a halberd) in order to kill a [[Monkey]]. Collect the [[Monkey corpse]] and take it back to [[Tamayu]] to be skinned and be given [[Monkey skin]].

Once you have both items use them on each other to create a [[Seaweed sandwich]] to give to [[Tinsay]].

Like before, do not use a [[monkey corpse]] on the [[seaweed]] before taking the monkey to Tamayu for skinning. This will create another joke item, [[Stuffed monkey]], and you will need to give the stuffed monkey to Tamayu to revert it back to its base components.

After you make the seaweed sandwich, use one of the [[karambwan vessel]]s on Tinsay to receive the [[Crafting manual]] for [[Tiadeche]]. He won't accept it until you make the sandwich.

====Marinated jogre bones====
{{Needed|[[Jogre bones]], a [[raw karambwanji]], a [[pestle and mortar]]. Recommended: [[logs]], and a [[tinderbox]] (for cooking the pasty jogre bones).}}
{{Listen
|title = [[Tinsay Satisfied (Tai Bwo Wannai Trio)|Tinsay Satisfied]]
|align = right
|filename = Tinsay Satisfied (Tai Bwo Wannai Trio).ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays upon Tinsay agreeing to return to Tai Bwo Wannai.}}
{{Listen
|title = [[Tiadeche Thankful (Tai Bwo Wannai Trio)|Tiadeche Thankful]]
|align = right
|filename = Tiadeche Thankful (Tai Bwo Wannai Trio).ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays upon Tiadeche agreeing to return to Tai Bwo Wannai..}}
You now need to get some burnt jogre bones marinated in karambwanji sauce. '''Be careful not to bury the bones!''' The bones can be accidentally buried at any step in this process.

# Use the jogre bones on a '''tinderbox''' to burn them. It will take a couple of seconds for them to finish burning, after which you can pick them up. If your [[Firemaking]] level is below level 30, you will not be able to burn the jogre bones with a tinderbox. Instead, you will have to burn them in a '''[[furnace]]'''. Alternatively, cast '''[[Superheat Item]]''' on the jogre bones.
# Grind a [[raw karambwanji]] with your [[pestle and mortar]].
# Use the [[Karambwanji paste|paste]] on the [[Burnt jogre bones|burnt bones]] to get [[pasty jogre bones]].
# Cook the pasty jogre bones on a [[range]] or [[fire]] to marinate them, and give the [[marinated j' bones]] to Tinsay. Note: These bones should be green in colour. If you cooked the bones wrong, they will be white instead.

Like before, do not use the karambwanji paste on the jogre bones before burning the jogre bones. This will create another joke item, useless [[marinated j' bones]] (which will be white, not green). You will have to get new jogre bones and karambwanji paste.

Now that you've helped Tinsay, he will regain his sanity and agree to return to Tai Bwo Wannai. Before leaving, give a spare [[karambwan vessel]] to Tinsay and receive the [[Crafting manual]]. 

Return to Tiadeche with the [[Crafting manual]], and they will both return to Tai Bwo Wannai.


===Wrapping up===
After you're done with all three brothers, talk to [[Timfraku]] up the ladder in the north-west house of [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] again to complete the quest. 

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

'''Note''': You must talk to each of the three brothers in their houses along the southern fence of the village to receive the additional experience rewards.
