==Walkthrough==
{{Map|align=right|zoom=2|x=3482|y=3278|mtype=pin|width=250|height=250|caption=Where to start the quest.}}
:'''Note:''' The only nearby bank is unlocked during [[In Aid of the Myreque]]. It is recommended to bring all required items with you on your first visit to Mort'ton.
===Starting the quest===
[[File:Diary (Shades of Mort'ton) detail.png|left|70px]]
Head to the most south-western house in Mort'ton and search the shelf on the wall to find a [[Diary (Shades of Mort'ton)|book]]. '''You should also search the [[smashed table (Mort'ton)|smashed table]], as it contains two [[Tarromin]] and [[Rogue's purse]].''' The Tarromin will allow you to create additional potions later on, and you may save the Rogue's purse if you plan to do [[Zogre Flesh Eaters]]. This building also contains a vial spawn in case you didn't bring vials of water with you. You can fill the vials in the sink in the easternmost building.

===Serum 207 and killing shades===
{{Needed|1000+ [[coins]], 2 [[tarromin potion (unf)]] (or 2 [[tarromin]] and 2 [[vials of water]]), 2 [[ashes]], [[food]], [[armour]], and a [[weapon]]|skills={{SCP|Herblore|15}} {{Boostable|yes}} to create [[Serum 207]]}}
[[File:Serum 207 (4) detail.png|left|70px]]
Reading the book will now allow you to create [[Serum 207]], a potion which may be used on the afflicted in town to '''temporarily''' interact with them. If you don't already have a [[tarromin potion (unf)]], use [[tarromin]] on a [[vial of water]] ({{SCP|Herblore|12}}). Use [[ashes]] on the unfinished potion to create the Serum (also complete your second potion) ({{SCP|Herblore|15}}).

:'''Note''': Serum 207 can be bought on the [[Grand Exchange]], but you must make at least one yourself for the purpose of this quest.

[[File:Razmire General Store..png|thumb|250px]]

Use the Serum on [[Razmire Keelgan]] in the [[general store]]. Ask him what all these shadowy creatures are, and he will tell you they are restless spirits of the dead. He asks you to kill 5 [[Loar Shade]]s (the level 40 green shadows) and collect their [[Loar remains|remains]] so that he may do some experiments on them.

:'''Note''': The kills will only count after Razmire has asked you to kill them, and you must collect the remains via killing them.

{{mes|That's all five Shades!}} will appear in the chat when you are done. Return to Razmire and use the Serum 207 on Razmire again, and he will take two of the shade remains from you. He then mentions that [[Ulsquire Shauncy]] might also be interested in seeing some shade remains.

Before heading to Ulsquire, open the general store through Razmire and buy some [[olive oil]]. Then ask him to open the builders store, and buy 1-2 [[timber beam]], 1-2 [[limestone brick]], and 10-20 [[swamp paste]].

:'''Note''': The supplies may be much more expensive on World 377 (the official Shades of Mor'ton minigame world) due to players buying them up, so consider switching worlds temporarily before buying them.

Ulsquire can be found in the house right next to Razmire to the south-east. Give him a dose of Serum 207, and then one of your [[shade remains]]. Talk to him again, and ask what he found out from the remains. Ulsquire believes that the tormented spirits should be put to rest, and jokes about rebuilding the nearby [[Flamtaer|temple]] and experimenting with the sacred flame. Next, ask him what he can tell you about the temple. He will suggest that to rebuild it, you will need the items you have just bought from Razmire. {{Chat option|1What did you find out about the remains?|2What can you tell me about that temple?}}

:'''Note''': Make sure you complete the dialogue options with Ulsquire, or interacting with the temple will result in the message {{Mes|You're not quite sure how to fix this}}.

===Repairing the Temple===
{{Main|Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)}}
{{needed|[[Hammer]] or [[Flamtaer hammer]], [[food]], [[armour]], [[Weapons|weapon]], [[tinderbox]], [[logs]] or [[axe]], [[loar remains]], [[olive oil]], and 1+ [[Serum 207|doses of Serum 207]] (2+ recommended). Building materials: multiples of [[limestone brick]], [[timber beam]], 5 [[swamp paste]]|recommended=1-2 [[Flamtaer bracelet]]s are recommended|skills={{SCP|Crafting|20}} {{Boostable|yes}} to repair the temple walls, {{SCP|Herblore|15}} {{Boostable|yes}} if choosing to create [[serum 208]]}}
 [[File:Flaming Fire altar.png|left|70px]]
[[File:Flamtaer.png|thumb|250px|The Flamtaer temple when fully repaired with the fire altar lit.]]
Now, you must help rebuild the temple located on a small island north-east of the general store, in order to create the sacred oil needed for a pyre funeral.

This section of the quest serves as a short introduction to the Shades of Mort'ton [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)|minigame]]. It is possible to complete this solo if using several [[Flamtaer bracelet]]'s along with the [[Flamtaer hammer]], but you may consider using the official World 377 dedicated to this minigame to find other players also rebuilding the temple, as this will make the process '''significantly faster'''.

In this minigame, players work together to rebuild the temple while under attack from [[Loar Shade]]s. To complete this quest, rebuild the walls around the temple using your hammer and build materials ({{SCP|Crafting|20}}). The [[Flamtaer hammer]] and [[Flamtaer bracelet]] make this process approximately 75% faster (the bracelet degrades after 80 uses). Once fully rebuilt, ignite the flame and then use the [[olive oil]] on it to create [[sacred oil]], provided you have at least 10% Sanctity. Sanctity is earned by your contribution towards repairing or reinforcing the walls, or by killing [[Loar Shades]] (only recommended for high combat levels).

:'''Note''': Once you have your sacred oil, it is optional but '''highly recommended''' to use your remaining [[Serum 207]] on the flame with at least 20% Sanctity, to create [[Serum 208]] ({{SCP|Herblore|15}}). This will permanently cure [[Razmire]] and [[Ulsquire]], making them permanently available for dialogue and trade. It may also be used on other [[afflicted]] citizens for a small [[Serum_208#Cure_rewards|reward]].

===Burning a Shade===
[[File:Shades of Mort'ton - Burning shade remains.gif|thumb|right|250px||The Shade spirit is now free!]]
{{Needed|[[Sacred oil]], [[logs]] or [[axe]], [[loar remains]], [[tinderbox]]|skills={{SCP|Firemaking|5}} {{Boostable|yes}} to use pyre logs on the funeral pyre}}

If you do not yet have logs, cut down a nearby [[dead tree]]. Use your sacred oil on the [[logs]] to receive a [[pyre logs|pyre log]]. Then, head over to one of the funeral pyres, which are the brown patches on the map west of the General Store. Use the pyre logs on the funeral pyre, followed by the [[Loar remains]]. Light this and you will see a spirit rise from the pyre. ({{SCP|Firemaking|5}})

Collect your reward from the stone pillar next to the pyre and head back to Ulsquire. Speak with him to prompt the end of the quest (use a serum if he has reverted to being afflicted).

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

[[#Walkthrough|(Return to Trials Map)]]
===Olaf the Bard=== '''Note: If obtaining the Lyre as a drop from [[Lanzig]], [[Borrokar]], [[Lensa]] or [[Freidir]], you MUST start the trial by speaking to Olaf the Bard FIRST, otherwise the Lyre will not drop.''' '''''Items needed for Option 1:''' An [[axe]], [[knife]], [[raw shark]]/raw [[raw manta ray|ray]]/raw [[raw sea turtle|turtle]], [[potato]], [[onion]], [[cabbage]], (requires {{SCP|Fletching|25}} {{SCP|Woodcutting|40}} {{SCP|Crafting|40}}; vegetables obtained for free in Rellekka).'' '''''Items needed for Option 2:''' Combat equipment and a [[raw shark]]/[[Raw manta ray|manta ray]]/[[raw sea turtle|turtle]] '' You should see [[Olaf the Bard|Olaf]] east of the bar building where you started the quest. He'll give you his vote if you can prove your worth as a bard by performing at the longhall. The first thing you need is a lyre. There are two ways to get a [[lyre]]: *'''Option 1:''' '''Note: You MUST start the trial by speaking with [[Olaf the Bard]] BEFORE speaking with [[Lalli]] or else he will not tell you about the other human.''' [[File:The Fremennik Trials - Swaying tree.png|thumb|230px|Cutting the Swaying tree.]] Make a lyre yourself. First, grab a [[potato]], [[cabbage]], and [[onion]] from the vegetable patch in [[Rellekka]] before you leave. Once you leave the gates, head east until you find a [[Swaying tree]], and cut a branch off it. Then use a knife on the branch. If you forgot to bring a knife, there is a knife spawn a few tiles north of the mining area in Rellekka. You will need an axe (blessed will not work) and a [[Woodcutting]] level of 40 in order to cut the tree and a Crafting level of 40 to make the unfinished lyre. You will then need to string the unfinished lyre, but unfortunately only golden wool will work. Head south-east of the tree until you find several golden sheep and a golden tree. Near them will be a troll called [[Lalli]], who will initially think you want the apples when you want the wool. He will tell you that he already gave it to another human, so go find him. The other human is [[Askeladden]], who is the child located at the entrance of the long hall in Rellekka. Talk to him and he will give you a [[pet rock]] which he fooled Lalli with. Return to Lalli with the rock, but he will refuse it because the rocks might have baby rocks, so tell him that you can make a delicious rock soup with it. {{Map|mtype=pin|align=left|caption=Lalli's located at the Golden tree; Fossegrimen will enchant your finished lyre at the Strange altar. |2626,3598,desc:The location of the [[Strange altar]]. |2741,3638,desc:The location of the [[swaying tree]]. |2766,3608,desc:The location of the [[Golden tree]]. }} {{Map|2675,3665|align=right|mtype=square|r=3|caption=Lanzig's location.}} '''Use''' the potato, cabbage, onion, and pet rock on Lalli's stew, which is just outside Lalli's cave home. Ask Lalli to taste it; he will like it and give you some golden fleece. The fleece will need to be strung into a ball of wool; even though there is a [[spinning wheel]] in Rellekka, you cannot use that until the quest is finished, so you will need to go to Seers' Village instead. Use the ball of wool on the unfinished lyre, which will require 25 Fletching. '''Note:''' If you plan to create multiple lyres, use the [[drop trick]] to collect multiple fleece before proceeding. Once Olaf the Bard's trial is complete, you will not be able to get more fleece from Lalli until the entire Fremennik Trials quest is complete, and Lalli will then charge you 1,000 coins per fleece. '''Option 2:''' Kill [[Lanzig]], [[Borrokar]], [[Lensa]], or [[Freidir]] in and around the buildings on the eastern side of Rellekka until they drop the lyre, each have a 1/17 chance to drop it. They all have a very quick respawn time and are located a short distance from each other. For mage and range users, you can use the fires in the centre of the buildings to [[safespot]]. [[File:The_Fremennik_Trials_-_An_enchanted_performance.png|thumb|209x209px|A player performs with their lyre.]] Once you've obtained the lyre, you need to get it enchanted. Bring a [[raw shark]], [[raw manta ray]], or [[raw sea turtle]] with you (if you have more than one lyre to enchant, then bring '''one fish for each lyre''' you wish to have enchanted; if using raw sharks, try to get raw sharks from Rufus' Meat Emporium in Canifis over a period of time). South-west of Rellekka is a [[strange altar]] located on a small peninsula. With the lyre in your inventory, use your raw shark/manta ray/sea turtle on the strange altar. A spirit named [[Fossegrimen]] will appear and enchant your lyre for you. Enter the door the Longhall Bouncer is guarding to go onstage. ('''Note:''' Drop any extra enchanted lyres, or they will become unenchanted). Play your lyre in front of the crowd, then talk to Olaf a final time to get his vote. ===Sigli the Huntsman=== {{Needed|recommended=Some [[food]], [[armour]], a [[weapon]] (preferably wind spells or a halberd), and [[prayer potion]]s.}} [[File:The Fremennik Trials - Fighting the Draugen.png|thumb|250x250px|A player fights the Draugen.]] Sigli can be found near the entrance gate. Your task is to find the [[Draugen]], an immortal spirit, and defeat it to weaken it. Keep using the [[hunters' talisman]] he gives you to find where to go. The talisman is used the same way you might use a [[Runecraft]] [[talisman]]; selecting locate gives a chat message in the direction to go. The Draugen moves around the [[Fremennik Province]] and can cross bridges. There is a small, transparent-looking [[Butterfly (Draugen)|butterfly]] that follows the Draugen. It can be used to help locate him. Use the talisman on the exact tile the Draugen is on to fight him. Level 48 [[Agility]] can help by allowing you access to the [[log balance (Fremennik Province)|log balance]] shortcut, as the Draugen has a random location that changes frequently. One slow method to find the [[Draugen]] is to sit near the bridge to the east of the strange altar and camp in a spot. Eventually, the Draugen will appear, announced by a chat message, "The Draugen is here! Beware!" With the proper [[Equipment|gear]], a level-50 player should defeat him without problems. Despite having high magic defensive bonuses, the Draugen's Magic level of 1 results in spells being very accurate on it, and its 50% air weakness can be exploited for even better damage. Melee performs second best, with Ranged being the least effective combat style. When you defeat him, the Draugen's essence will be absorbed into the [[hunters' talisman]]. Return with the talisman to [[Sigli the Huntsman|Sigli]] to get his vote.
[[The Fremennik Trials#Walkthrough|(Return to Trials Map)]]
===Sigmund the Merchant=== {{Needed|5,000 [[coins]].}} You can find [[Sigmund the Merchant (shop)|Sigmund]] in the market. He will want you to get him an [[exotic flower]]. This may sound easy, but you will end up having to get something or do something for another person, kind of like a miniature [[One Small Favour]] quest. Refer to [[The Fremennik Trials#Walkthrough|the map above]] to easily locate the [[NPC]]s. '''DO NOT''' lose the items that the people give you; otherwise, you must start over and talk to Askeladden for the promissory note again. #First, talk to the Sailor on the dock (second pier from the left) about the flower. Ask him about the Merchant's Trial. He will want a romantic [[Fremennik ballad|ballad]] composed for him. #Talk to [[Olaf the Bard]]. He will ask you to get him a pair of [[Sturdy boots|new boots]]. #Go to the clothing store (aside: the clothing store is also the starting point of the Rellekka agility course on this building, so in your minimap, you can see the Agility icon) which can be found west of Sigmund, and ask [[Yrsa]] about them. She will only agree to make the boots if [[Brundt the Chieftain]] will lower the taxes on the stores. #If you talk to Brundt in the longhall, he will tell you that the clan can afford it if [[Sigli the Huntsman]] will show him the best places to hunt monsters. #Talk to Sigli just south of the longhall. He agrees, but first will want a [[Custom bow string|custom-made bowstring]]. #Go to the helmet store just north of the longhall. The shopkeeper, [[Skulgrimen]], will give you the bowstring in exchange for the [[Unusual fish|rare fish]] that the fisherman caught. #Head to the dock located west of the helmet shop ([[Torfinn]] is on this dock) and talk to the fisherman on the northern end of the dock. He will ask you to get a [[Sea fishing map|map]] of the best spots to catch edible fish. #Find [[Swensen the Navigator]], located in the building south of the marketplace. He will make the map, but will want a [[weather forecast]] first. #[[Peer the Seer]] is found just north-west of Swensen. He will give you a forecast if [[Thorvald the Warrior]] agrees to be his bodyguard. #[[Thorvald the Warrior]] is in the helmet store. He wants you to get him a seat in the longhall. #[[Manni the Reveller]] is found in the longhall. He will gladly give up his seat if [[Thora the Barkeep]] will make him one of her [[legendary cocktail]]s. #Thora, also in the longhall, will only agree to make one if you can get a signed note from [[Askeladden]] for him to stay out of the bar. #Talk to Askeladden, just south of the longhall, to get the note for 5000 [[coins]]. #Then, give the note to Thora, the cocktail to Manni, the [[Champions token|token]] to Thorvald, the [[Warriors' contract|contract]] to Peer, the forecast to Swensen, the chart to the fisherman, the fish to Skulgrimen (helmet shop), the string to Sigli, the [[Tracking map|map]] to Brundt, the [[Fiscal statement|slip]] to Yrsa (clothes shop), the boots to Olaf (East of longhall), the ballad to the sailor (the second dock from the left in Rellekka), and finally the flower to Sigmund. You will get his vote.
[[The Fremennik Trials#Walkthrough|(Return to Trials Map)]]
===Swensen the Navigator=== Talk to [[Swensen the Navigator|Swensen]] in his house, south-west of the longhall. Your task is to navigate your way through his maze of portals. Enter the maze by going down the ladder in the south-west of his house. In each room of the maze, there are four portals: One on the north wall, one on the south wall, one on the east wall, and one on the west wall. In the brighter rooms with burning torches, one of the portals will take you to the next room on the correct path. The other three will send you to a dim room, with extinguished torches, spider webs, and skeletons. The darker rooms are dead ends, their portals only lead to other dead ends, you must climb the rope and start over. The trick is to spell his name. First, go in the '''S'''outh portal, then the '''W'''est, then '''E'''ast, then '''N'''orth, then '''S'''outh, then '''E'''ast, and finally '''N'''orth again ''(SWENSEN)''. After you finish, talk to Swensen to get his vote (make sure to put your minimap focused with the north on the right spot).
[[The Fremennik Trials#Walkthrough|(Return to Trials Map)]]
===Thorvald the Warrior=== {{Needed|None (you will have to approach the trial with no weapons or armour)|recommended=[[Food]], [[prayer potion]]s, and combat potions. If you have low combat stats you may bring a [[god book]], [[rings of recoil]] (7 minimum), [[goblin paint cannon]], [[phoenix necklace]]s, a [[dramen branch]] and knife.}} *Note for [[Ultimate Ironman|Ultimate Ironmen]]: Looting bags are prohibited in this fight, regardless of their contents. *Note for [[Hardcore Group Ironmen]]: Dying to the 4th phase of the fight '''is a safe death'''. You do not actually die, the fight ends if you get to 1 health. [[Thorvald]] lives in the helmet store. His task is for you to fight a special warrior called [[Koschei the deathless]]. There are two rules: # You must fight and defeat him 3 times. Whenever he is defeated, he recovers his health and becomes much stronger. '''You only need to defeat Koschei for the first 3 rounds; if you die to him on the 4th round, you will pass Thorvald's trial.''' Dying to him in the first 3 rounds is also a '''safe death''', as no items will be lost and regular [[Hardcore ironmen]] will not lose their status. # You cannot use any [[weapons]], [[armour]], [[fletching]] materials (such as [[logs]]/[[arrowtips]]), or bring [[runes]]. The Ardougne cloak counts as armour, but the boots of lightness do not. However, you can use [[food]], [[Prayer]], [[god book]]s, and jewellery. H.A.M gear is suitable for combat with Koschei, as that counts as clothing, but it still gives some combat defence. [[Ring of recoil|Rings of recoil]] or the [[ring of suffering (ri)]] are strongly recommended. A [[Celastrus bark]] and a knife can be used to create a [[Battlestaff]]. There are also some things to note: * You are given the option to send your items to the bank before entering the basement. Talk to the [[Peer the Seer]] to do so. Note that '''all''' of your items, both equipped and in your inventory, will be banked if you have any equipment that you are not allowed to take in with you. However, you can drop your items on the ground before asking Peer the Seer to deposit your items, keeping them for the battle. Clue scrolls count as armour. * It is possible to flinch Koschei, but not recommended if you take too long to kill; he will despawn back to his first phase. * Do not wear a [[ring of life]] as you will be teleported back to your spawn point. You will need to fight him again at his first phase. * Reward caskets and/or mystery boxes may also be brought into the arena for their armour and weapon drops. Note that items '''cannot be dropped inside the arena''', so if you inventory is full and you must make space in it to pick up the rewards from the casket that will have dropped to the ground, you will have to eat food to make that space. It has not yet been tested whether trying to make inventory space by climbing the ladder back up, dropping items outside and coming back down will make the dropped rewards disappear. * It is possible to glitch the fight if you die, and if you come back quickly enough, it is possible to keep fighting him from the point at which you died, and ignore the second Koschei that pops up. * The time limit for the third form is 10 minutes. If you cannot beat Koschei's third form at this time, he will despawn, and you will have to reset. Stock up on the food and potions, then climb down to Thorvald's basement. When you enter the arena, Koschei is hidden. Simply roam around for a short while, and he will appear. [[File:The_Fremennik_Trials_-_Fighting_Koschei_the_deathless.png|thumb|Koschei's final form.]] Koschei's first form is easy and should give you no problems. After you defeat him, he will regain all of his health and become stronger. There is no way to safespot him as you have no weapons, but you can trap him over the hole and wait a while for your health to regenerate. However, if you stay there too long, he will disappear and reappear after you run around, back in his first form. His level is not displayed. His second form might give you a bit of trouble, and you might need to use food or Prayer. His third form is fairly difficult, so you will most likely need to use food and/or Prayer here. You may need a [[prayer potion]] here as it is possible to run out of prayer points early. This is the last form required for you to defeat to complete the quest. '''Note:''' Leaving after the 3rd fight resets your progress. Enter the 4th fight regardless and, should you lose, his fourth form may roam the area when you return. The fourth form is the hardest. He will hit once every game tick, but can only hit for 1 damage at a time. It is recommended that the player use a [[Ring of recoil]], but be sure to bring enough rings for the fight (7 minimum) as the ring breaks after 40 hitpoints of damage, and Koschei has 255 HP in this form. Some high level food will also be required to heal the damage taken using this method. In this form, Koschei will quickly drop your prayer points in intervals of 1-2 every second and will drop all of your prayer points as soon as the form starts. If you manage to beat Koschei in this form, you will be given a [[Fremennik blade]]. Otherwise, when Koschei leaves you at 1 hitpoint, you will kneel on the ground and find yourself upstairs. Regardless, Thorvald will give you his vote for your bravery in fighting a superior foe.

===Peer the Seer=== [[Peer the Seer|Peer]] is found south of the market. He'll give you his vote if you can simply enter the front door to his house, and then come out the other side. This is more difficult than it seems because you cannot take any items in, and you will encounter many puzzles inside. '''You can deposit all your items by completing the dialogue after Peer introduces his trial.''' '''Note:''' Because Peer will bank all of your items in your inventory, this should be done last to save a lot of time walking to and from the bank. ====Entering the house==== [[File:The Fremennik Trials - Combination Lock Door.png|thumb|The combination lock door before entering Peer the Seer's house.]] To get in, you need to answer a puzzle. The answer is a four-letter word and Peer will give you a clue for each letter and the word itself. All possible answers include: time, life, mage, fire, wind, mind, and tree. {| class="wikitable" !Riddle !Answer |- | *My first is in mage, but not in wizard. *My second in goblin, and also in lizard. *My third in night, but not in the day. *My last is in fields, but not in the hay. *My whole is the most powerful tool you will possess. |Mind |- | *My first is in tar, but not in a swamp. *My second in fire, but not in a camp. *My third is in eagle, but never in air. *My last is in hate, but also in care. *My whole wears more rings the older I get. |Tree |- | *My first is in the well, but not at sea. *My second in 'I', but not in 'me'. *My third in flies, but insects not found. *My last is in earth, but not in the ground. *My whole when stolen from you causes you death. |Life |- | *My first is in fish, but not in the sea. *My second in birds, but not in a tree. *My third is in doors, but not in a hall. *My last is everything, but nothing at all. *My whole cannot die as long as it has food. |Fire |- | *My first is in water, and also in tea. *My second is in fish, but not in the sea. *My third is in mountains, but not underground. *My last is in strike, but not like in pound. *My whole crushes mountains, drains rivers, and destroys civilisations. All that live fear my passing. |Time |- | *My first is in wizard, but not in a mage. *My second in jail, but not in a cage. *My third is in anger, but not in a rage. *My last in a drawing, but not on a page. *My whole helps to make bread, let birds fly and boats sail. |Wind |} ====Inside the house==== After you have solved the riddle, use the ladder. You now need to open a chest with a balancing mechanism as a lock to get a [[vase]]. To open it, you must set exactly four litres of water on it. To solve the puzzle, you will need some items found in the room; search and study everything until you find an [[old red disk]], a [[wooden disk]], a [[red herring]], an [[empty jug]], and an [[empty bucket]]. Once you have all of the items, you can solve the puzzle by doing the following: #Fill up the bucket from the tap south of the cooking range. #Use the [[full bucket]] on the jug to end up with a [[2/5ths full bucket]]. #Empty the [[full jug]] by using it on the drain. #Use the bucket on the jug to get a [[2/3rds full jug]]. #Fill up the bucket with the tap again, and then use the bucket on the jug to get a [[4/5ths full bucket]]. #Use the bucket on the locked chest to get the [[vase]]. #Use the [[red herring]] on the cooking range to receive [[sticky red goop]]. #Use the sticky red goop on the wooden disk so you have 2 [[red disk]]s. #Go down the east ladder and use both red disks on the [[abstract mural]] to receive the [[vase lid]]. #Use the full jug on the vase to get a [[vase of water]]. #Use the vase lid on the vase, creating a [[sealed vase]]. #Use the sealed vase on the [[frozen table]] to get a [[Frozen key (The Fremennik Trials)|frozen key]]. (frozen table is back up the ladder) #Unfreeze the key by cooking it on the range. #Go down the east ladder (Note: '''Use the east ladder nearest to the frozen table. If you exit using the other door, you will have to do some parts over again.''') and out the exit to get Peer's vote. Once you have all seven council members' votes, head back to [[Chieftain Brundt]], and speak to him to complete the quest. ==Walkthrough==
[[File:Isafdar map.png|thumb|right|400px|Map of Isafdar.]]
[[File:Islwyn chathead.png|left]]
Talk to [[Islwyn]] to start the quest. He will be found with his companion [[Eluned]] in one of two locations in [[Isafdar]]. Refer to the map for the possible locations and the routes towards them. Head towards either of these spots; if he isn't there, switch to another world until you find him. These elven woods may be reached by travelling with a [[charter ship]] ([[Port Tyras]]), using an [[Iorwerth camp teleport]] or by traversing through the [[Underground Pass (dungeon)|Underground Pass]] or by using the overpass of [[Arandar]].

Note that travelling through Isafdar can be rather dangerous due to the vast amount of traps, that deal up to 15 damage at once and may apply poison. Food and [[antipoison]] are recommended.

===Starting out===
After the events of [[Regicide]], the player decides to help the rebelling elves, led by [[Arianwyn]], against [[Lord Iorwerth]]'s apparent scheme to take over [[Camelot]]. Arianwyn sent out scouts, [[Islwyn]] and [[Eluned]], to guide you to their holdout. However, Islwyn seemingly distrusts any human and will not assist you, as it was an act of humans that led to his grandmother's death. He will mention that his grandmother was [[Glarial]], whose remains you moved from her [[Glarial's tomb|tomb]] to the [[Waterfall Dungeon]] during the [[Waterfall Quest]]. He will be surprised and relieved upon hearing this, as he believes this to be the perfect resting place for her.

Islwyn changes his mind and will help you, on the condition you complete the ritual of burying her. Speak with Eluned to learn about this ritual. She will tell you to retrieve the [[consecration seed]] from her previous resting place. Talk to Eluned before leaving for the tomb or you will not be able to retrieve the seed.

You will require [[Glarial's pebble]] to enter the tomb. If you have lost this, speak with [[Golrie]] in the [[Tree Gnome Village Dungeon]] to obtain another.

===The consecration seed===
{{Needed|[[Glarial's pebble]]}}
[[File:Glarial's tombstone.png|thumb|upright=0.65|[[Glarial's Tombstone]]]]
Having talked with Eluned, head towards [[Glarial's Tomb]] and use the pebble to enter it. Note that there will be many [[Glarial's Tomb#Restricted items|restrictions]] to entering the tomb.

[[File:Roving Elves moss giant.png|thumb|Fighting the [[Moss Guardian]].]]
You will need to kill any level-84 [[Moss Guardian]] to retrieve the consecration seed. Because of the restrictions towards entering the tomb, the simplest way to fight it is using unarmed melee. See the [[Glarial's Tomb#Allowed items|list of exceptions]] for alternatives, including Magic. [[Prayer]], [[food]], and [[potions]] may be used and it is advised to do so. As the Moss Guardian does physical damage, or unavoidable magical damage if the physical damage doesn't land, it is recommended to pray [[Protect from Melee]]. The [[ring of recoil]] will also prove effective. You can wield the [[goblin paint cannon]] to increase your attack speed, as it isn't restricted. You can wear [[H.A.M. robes|H.A.M. clothing]] for a little extra defence bonus. It is also possible to [[Flinching|flinch]] it by standing directly south of the south-eastern pillar when fighting the Moss Guardian directly west of the entrance.

Take the [[consecration seed]] back to [[Eluned]], who has possibly moved to the other location shown on the map. If she has moved, you can switch worlds until she appears. She will enchant the seed by casting a silent spell on it. If you lose the seed after this point, you may return to her for a new one.

===Through the waterfall===
{{Needed|[[Glarial's amulet]],[[Rope]], [[Spade]], [[Key (Waterfall Dungeon)|Key]] (found in the Waterfall Dungeon) and the '''enchanted''' [[consecration seed]].

Note: After completing Waterfall Quest and the Kandarin Medium Diary, permanent ropes are now in place at Baxtorian Falls for easy dungeon access.}}

Travel to the [[Waterfall Dungeon]] with all the required items. Similar to how you entered it during the [[Waterfall Quest]], board the raft in the middle of the lake above the [[Baxtorian Falls]]. It will crash just before the waterfall. Then, ''use'' the rope on the rock to the south, followed by using the rope once again on the dead tree hanging on the edge. You will then find yourself in front of the dungeon entrance.

Inside the dungeon, search the northernmost crates in the eastern room to find a [[Key (Waterfall Dungeon)|key]]. With this key, open the locked doors in the western rooms, and proceed to the room with the [[Chalice of Eternity]]. Bury the seed anywhere next to the chalice to complete the ritual, laying [[Glarial]]'s spirit to rest.
[[File:Planting consecration seed.gif|thumb|The player plants the [[consecration seed]], with a crystal tree growing afterwards.]]

===Ending===
Head back to [[Islwyn]] to claim your reward. You will be given a choice between a free, but partly used, [[crystal shield]] or [[crystal bow]]. Both can be bought later from him, for {{NoCoins|750,000}} and {{NoCoins|900,000}} coins respectively. These items have charges that deplete when using them, after which they will become unusable until recharged by [[Ilfeen]], for a varying cost.

You will need the crystal bow for the [[Hard Western Provinces Diary]]. Therefore, in addition to its higher cost, it is advised to take the bow.

If you have the requirements to start [[Mourning's End Part I]], it's highly recommended to speak to [[Eluned]] after claiming your reward in order to start the quest. By doing so, Eluned will teleport you to [[Arianwyn]] in [[Lletya]], while also granting you a [[teleport crystal]] with 4 charges that can be used to teleport there (and [[Prifddinas]] upon completion of the [[Song of the Elves]] quest). Eluned may have moved locations during the prior dialogue; in this case just switch worlds until she reappears.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
[[File:Ali Morrisane chathead.png|left]]
Talk to [[Ali Morrisane]] in [[Al Kharid]], located just south-west of the [[Emir's Arena]] teleport. He will claim to be the greatest salesman in the world, and when the player questions this, he will complain about his lack of staff. Agree to help him, and he will ask you to find [[Ali]] in [[Pollnivneach]], his nephew who had agreed to join his stall as an assistant.

If you haven't already, buy the [[Kharidian headpiece]] and [[fake beard]] from Ali Morrisane. You may choose to combine them into a [[desert disguise]] now to save inventory space, as this will be required later in the quest. You may also consider purchasing [[waterskin]]s and [[desert clothing]] to protect from the [[desert heat]].

Go to the little village of Pollnivneach, which is south-east of [[Shantay Pass]]. 200 [[coins]] will get you there on the [[magic carpet]], which completes an easy [[Desert Diary]] task.
:'''Note:''' If you see the huge wall, you must go '''east''' to enter the village.

===Starting in Pollnivneach===
[[File:The Asp & Snake Bar..png|thumb|right|220px|The Asp & Snake Bar]]
Head to the [[The Asp & Snake Bar.|bar]] in the south-eastern corner of the village. Buy 3 [[beer]]s from [[Ali the Barman]] if you don't already have some, and then talk to [[Drunken Ali]], who will ask for beer in return for information. '''Use''' each beer on him, '''completing each dialogue before continuing'''. He will tell you that [[Ali Morrisane]]'s nephew is in trouble with the gangs, but you won't get any information out of them while they are feuding.

Head west of the bar to a purple and yellow tent, and talk to any [[Menaphite Thug]] (not [[Ali the Operator]]). They will mention that the feud started after the Bandits stole a camel from them. 

Talk to any bandit in the north part of the town, who will blame the feud on the Menaphites stealing a camel from them.

Talk to [[Ali the Camel Man]] at the building north-west of the bar, south of the kebab store, and ask to buy two camels. Offer him 500 [[coins]] to receive two camel [[Receipt (The Feud)|receipts]]. Return to any Menaphite thug in the southern part of town, and then any Bandit in the northern part of town, to give each receipt. Both gangs will be outraged at the offering.

Talk to [[Ali the Operator]] by the purple tent south-west of Pollnivneach, and ask him if you can join his gang. He will ask the player to [[Thieving#Pickpocketing|pickpocket]] 3 [[villager]]s to prove themselves.

===Picking the villagers' pockets===
[[File:The Feud - knocking out villager.png|thumb|220px|Knocking out one of the [[villager]]s.]]
*'''1st villager''' – Simply head out and [[Thieving#Pickpocketing|pickpocket]] any villager. You will always fail unless you have spoken with [[Ali the Operator]]. 
*'''2nd villager''' – Go and talk to a [[Street urchin]] in or around the bar, and pay him 10 [[coins]] to distract a [[villager]], then quickly pickpocket the villager with the flashing arrow above his head. Make sure that the Street urchin is nearby one of the villagers, otherwise he will tell you that there is none around to distract. You must approach the villager from behind. If it fails, you will not lose your payment: talk to the urchin to try again.
*'''3rd villager''' – Talk to Ali the Operator again and ask for advice: he will give you a [[blackjack]]. Equip it, then lure a villager (into a secluded area in an empty building), knock them out with the blackjack, and finally pick their pocket (all options are right click).

===The second job===
[[File:The Feud - cracking the safe.png|thumb|220px|Cracking the safe.]]

Return to [[Ali the Operator]], who now wants you to steal the mayor's wife's [[jewels]] from the safe in their villa. He will give you [[keys]] to the front door. Combine the [[fake beard]] with the [[Kharidian headpiece]] to make a [[desert disguise]], then equip it and your [[gloves]]. If you did not buy these from [[Ali Morrisane]], you can get them from the [[Market seller]] at the general store icon on the map. The villa is north-east of the bar; on the huge [[Cactus (The Feud)|cactus]] just outside, click '''Hide behind'''.

When the dialogue appears and tells you that it is safe to go in since nobody is home, use your key on the door and go in.

On the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}, search the landscape picture hanging beside the bed to discover the safe. The numbers on the safe progress from 1-9 (clockwise), and you must click '''1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8''', on the dial to unlock it and take the jewels. This solution is the {{Wp|Fibonacci sequence}}, and you would have found a clue by searching the bed for a note which gives the first 5 numbers of the sequence.

:'''Note:''' If you do not have at least one [[inventory]] space open, you will have to enter this sequence again.

===The third job===
[[File:The Feud - Ali the Hag.png|thumb|220px|Talking to the [[Ali the Hag|Hag]].]]
Give the [[jewels]] to [[Ali the Operator]]. For your final task, he wants you to root out a traitor within the gang. 

Talk to a [[Menaphite Thug]] gang member about it, who will suggest that the traitor must be Traitorous Ali. Return to Ali the Operator who will ask the player to quietly kill him. 

Talk to [[Ali the Barman]] to find out that the beer on the table belongs to the traitor. Go talk to [[Ali the Hag]] up the hill to the west of the town, who will agree to make a poison for you if you can get her a [[snake]].

[[File:The Feud - snake charming.png|thumb|left|220px|Charming the [[snake]].]]
Now, go around the back of the pub, and put some [[coins]] in the snake charmer's money pot. He will give you a [[snake charm]] and a [[snake basket]]. 

Use ('''not''' Play) the snake charm on a desert snake, which can be found north of Ali the Operator's tent. You may fail to charm the snake causing it to attack you, simply kill it and then try again on another snake.

:'''Note''': You may have a snake charm already in your bank if you have completed [[Ratcatchers]]. You may receive another now if you have lost it.
{{Listen
|title = [[Snake Charming (The Feud)|Snake Charming]]
|align = right
|filename = Snake Charming (The Feud).ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays upon charming a snake.}}

Once you've brought the snake back to [[Ali the Hag]], she will tell you the second item she needs is fresh [[Ugthanki dung|camel dung]]. Go to [[Ali the Kebab seller]], located just north-west of the well in the centre of town, and ask for his [[red hot sauce]]. Take this to the camel shop, and use it on the food trough. A pile of [[Dung (scenery)|dung]] will appear after a few seconds; if it's green, repeat until you get brown dung. Use a [[bucket]] on it to obtain the desired Ugthanki dung.

:'''Tip:''' Consider gathering 3 more pieces of dung for [[My Arm's Big Adventure]], and 1 for [[Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf]] (where there is a 1/25 chance to need one).

Take the dung to Ali the Hag and she'll give you some poison to kill [[Traitorous Ali]].

Go to the pub, use the poison on the table with the beer, and then go back to Ali the Operator.

<gallery mode="packed" heights="150">
The Feud - pouring hot sauce.png|Pouring the [[red hot sauce]] on the trough.
The Feud - poisonining drink.png|Pouring the hag's poison onto Traitorous Ali's drink.
</gallery>

===Defeating the gang leaders===
[[File:The Feud - Tough Guy safespot.png|thumb|220px|The [[safespot]] for the [[Tough Guy]].]]

Prepared for a fight, talk to [[Ali the Operator]], who wants you to meet the [[Menaphite Leader]]. Speak to him outside the tent to discover that the Menaphites have world domination plans. After the player declines his offer to join them, the leader will summon a level 75 [[Tough Guy]] to attack you. You can [[safespot]] him behind the table inside the Menaphite Tent.

After defeating him, talk to a [[villager]]; they are angry with you for upsetting the balance of power and will tell you that you need to deal with the [[Bandit Leader]] too. He's just north-west of the village by the [[Rug Merchant]].

[[File:The Feud - Bandit champion safespot.png|thumb|220px|The ideal safespot for the [[bandit champion]].]]

Talk to the bandit leader, who will refuse to leave unless you can defeat their strongest warrior in battle, summoning a level 70 [[bandit champion]]. There is a safespot in the house directly east; run to the north side of the table and manoeuvre him until he is directly behind the table and beside the chair, then run to the other side of the chair. Upon defeat, he will drop an [[adamant scimitar]] if the player has a [[willow blackjack]] in their inventory.

Talk to the villagers, who will still be unimpressed by your actions so far and tell you to talk to the Mayor if you are looking for a reward. 

Talk to [[Ali the Mayor]] by the well in the centre of the village. He will be a little more grateful about the results of your deeds, and explain that he smuggled [[Ali Morrisane]]'s nephew out of the town after he angered the gangs.

Finally, return to Ali Morrisane, who reveals that the entire quest was an elaborate scheme to get the player involved in Pollnivneach 'tourism'.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===Optional Diary Tasks===
{{Needed|[[pickaxe]], [[bracelet of clay]] or 4 [[clay]], [[bird snare]]|recommended=[[Digsite pendant]] or [[Digsite teleport]], a woodcutting axe for another diary task later|skills={{SCP|Thieving|25}} {{Boostable|yes}} to steal a phoenix feather, {{SCP|Hunter|5}} {{Boostable|yes}} to catch a golden warbler}}
This quest takes place in the vicinity of several diary tasks which may be optionally completed. This is recommended as several of the tasks may also save you time during the quest. You may choose to teleport to [[Eagles' Eyrie]] with the [[necklace of passage]], complete the tasks and then head south-east towards the Ruins of [[Uzer]] where the quest takes place.

{{Checklist|
*Steal a [[Phoenix feather]] from the [[Desert Phoenix]] ({{SCP|Thieving|25}}) for both a medium [[Desert Diary]] task and use in the quest itself.
*Mine 5 pieces of [[clay]] for an easy [[Desert Diary]] task (4 of which can be used in the quest itself but require a method such as mining it with a bracelet of clay to turn it into [[soft clay]]).
*Catch a [[Golden warbler|Golden Warbler]] with a [[Bird snare|Bird Snare]] ({{SCP|Hunter|5}}) for an easy [[Desert Diary]] task.
*Fill a [[Waterskin]] with water by cutting a Khardian cactus with a [[knife]] for an easy [[Desert Diary]] task.
}}

{{Map|3422,3162|r=5|mtype=square|align=right|width=220|height=220|caption=The clay mining spot. The desert phoenix can also be found nearby.}}

===Repairing the golem===
{{Needed|4 [[soft clay]] '''or''' a [[bracelet of clay]] and a [[pickaxe]]|recommended=[[Digsite pendant]] or [[Digsite teleport]], a woodcutting axe for a diary task|skills={{SCP|Woodcutting|35}} {{Boostable|yes}} if completing an optional diary task}}

Travel to the Ruins of [[Uzer]]. You can use a [[necklace of passage]] to the [[Eagles' Eyrie]] or [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|dlq}}.

Talk to the broken clay golem to learn it is in need of repair. Use each piece of [[soft clay]] on it to slowly repair it. If you didn't already, you can mine [[clay]] at the north-western mine with a [[bracelet of clay]]. If you didn't bring a bracelet, there is a [[jug of water]] in the [[Oasis]] to the south of Uzer that may be used on the clay to make soft clay (world hop to respawn it).

Once fully repaired, the golem will explain that he was programmed to destroy a powerful demon, [[Thammaron]], and that he needs assistance to open a portal to defeat it. '''Ask him how to open the portal''',  and he will explain that four statuettes in the temple must be turned to the correct pattern, but he doesn't know it. 

Outside the temple ruins, near the golem, there is a [[Letter (The Golem)|letter]]. Take the letter and read it; it describes how an expedition here was discontinued after the opening of [[The Digsite]] near [[Varrock]].

Head east into the temple by climbing down the stairs behind the golem. Once inside, pick a [[black mushroom]] by the entrance, then pick up the [[strange implement]] in the north-western corner.

:'''Tip:''' Pick a second for [[Shadow of the Storm]], and keep the strange implement for the same quest. If you brought an axe, you may also choose to complete a medium [[Desert Diary]] task here by cutting the [[Teak tree]] ({{SCP|Woodcutting|35}}) behind the ruins, indicated on the minimap with a tree icon.

===The Digsite===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Thieving|25}} {{Boostable|yes}} to pickpocket Curator Haig}}
{{Map|name=Elissa|x=3374|y=3434|r=4|mtype=square|align=left|width=240|height=240|caption=The location of Elissa.}}
Head to the north-eastern corner of the [[Digsite]] to find [[Elissa]], the author of the letter. The fastest method of reaching her is a [[digsite pendant]] or [[gnome glider]].

Talk to her about the letter, and she will suggest you look in the [[Exam Centre]] for her late husband's notes, the man whom led the discontinued Uzer expedition.

Head to the [[Exam Centre]] and search the south-eastern most bookshelf to find [[Varmen's notes]]. '''Read them''' before progressing; Varmen describes in detail the discovery of the golems and the great city of [[Uzer]], and mentions taking a statuette from the ruins. Return to Elissa and ask where the statuette went, and she will point you towards the [[Varrock Museum]].

[[File:The Golem - stealing statuette.png|thumb|224px|The player steals the statuette.]]

Go to the [[Varrock Museum]] and ask [[Curator Haig Halen]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} about a missing statuette. Then, [[pickpocket]] him to get a [[display cabinet key]] ({{SCP|Thieving|25}}).

:'''Note:''' Ensure that you have read the notes and completed all prior dialogue if the dialogue options do not appear.

Unlock Display Case 30 upstairs to steal the [[statuette (The Golem)|statuette]]. It is on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} in the first row, the fourth case after you ascend the stairs.

:'''Note:''' If you lose the statuette, you can use the display cabinet key on the empty display cabinet to receive a new one.

{{Clear|left}}

===Returning to Uzer===
{{Needed|An empty [[vial]], [[pestle and mortar]], [[statuette (The Golem)|statuette]], black mushroom (obtainable in Uzer dungeon), Strange implement, [[papyrus]], [[Phoenix feather]] (obtainable near the clay mines north of [[Uzer]]), [[chisel]] and [[hammer]] (optional, for cutting [[gems]]).}}

[[File:The Golem - desert phoenix.png|thumb|left|210px|The Desert Phoenix, near the clay mine.]]
[[File:The Golem - the alcove.png|thumb|200px|The alcove in the centre where the statuette goes.]]
[[File:The Golem - Thammaron's remains.png|thumb|200px|The dead demon.]]
Ensure you have the required items and return to [[Uzer]]. Enter the dungeon near the golem, then use the statuette on the empty alcove on the wall in the centre. Turn all of the statuettes north to face towards the [[Door (Ruins of Uzer)|double doors]] to unlock the demon's lair. The east statues should face right and the west statues should face left when the player examines them. The statues will lock and the doors will automatically open. Go inside to discover that [[Thammaron]] had succumbed to his wounds long ago after the battle with the golems.

:'''Note:''' You may optionally use a chisel and hammer on the [[Throne (Thammaron's throne room)|throne]] to take 2 cut [[rubies]], 2 [[emeralds]], and 2 [[sapphires]]  for yourself.

Return to the golem to inform him of the demon's death. He does not believe the player - you will need to reprogram him to put his mind to rest.

With an empty vial in your inventory, use your pestle and mortar on the black mushroom to make [[black dye]]. Use the phoenix feather on your ink to make a [[phoenix quill pen]], then use it on your papyrus to write a [[Golem program]].

Use the strange implement on the golem followed by the golem program, and the golem will declare that his task is complete.

==Walkthrough==
===Getting started===
To start, speak to [[Juna]] in the [[Chasm of Tears]], reached through an entrance at the south end of the [[Lumbridge Swamp Caves]]. You will need a [[light source]] to navigate the caves. Since the quest requires a [[sapphire lantern]] later, it is advised to use this as the light source, making it before entering the caves to save a trip. Making the sapphire lantern does not require starting the quest—players can simply make it by adding a cut [[sapphire]] to an unlit [[bullseye lantern]] or [[bullseye lantern (unf)]] and then lighting it with a [[tinderbox]]. The lantern must be filled with [[lamp oil]] by bringing [[swamp tar]] to the [[lamp oil still]] at the [[chemist's house]] in [[Rimmington]] or the [[lamp still]] at the [[Dorgesh-Kaan]] market. The lens must be swapped and the lantern lit before entering the caves, as the game will not allow you to extinguish the bullseye lantern while in the dungeon or the chasm of tears.

'''If you have completed [[The Lost Tribe]] quest, you may skip to Option B. If not, use Option A. Partial completion is possible, you must only reach the point at which it is possible to obtain the [[brooch]].'''

====Option A====
Travel via the entrance in the [[Lumbridge swamp]]. You will need a [[rope]] if this is your first time entering the caves. Once inside, you will need to pass by several holes in the wall, which contain [[wall beast]]s that can grab you and do damage. A [[spiny helmet]] can be worn to reduce damage from the wall beasts, but an easier option is to just stop one square away from each hole and then run past it. Doing this will always successfully avoid the wall beast's grab. Be sure to also avoid getting hit by any [[cave crawler]]s as they can deal inflict a strong poison; they can be avoided by taking the south path. The small area in the middle south of the dungeon also contains swamp gas that will ignite any exposed light sources, dealing damage. This should not be an issue if only bringing the sapphire lantern.

The [[Chasm of Tears]] is found at through an exit to the south-east of your starting location. You will have to cross an agility obstacle which can be failed, but since you are using a covered light source it will not be extinguished. No damage is taken upon failing the obstacle and the player will still end up at the other side. Once inside, climb down the rocks and talk to Juna.

Skip to the '''Juna''' paragraph to continue.

====Option B====
If you have access to the second entrance from the [[Lumbridge cellar]], this provides a much faster and safer route to reach Juna, as there will be no wall beasts, cave crawlers, or swamp gas along the way. If this is your first time, you will have to use your pickaxe to clear the rocks to access the swamp caves. Simply head directly south from the entrance and cross the stepping stone to reach the Chasm of Tears, then climb down the rocks and talk to Juna.

===Juna===
Speak to [[Juna]] and choose to tell her stories about your adventures (you may also optionally choose to hear the lore about the place from her). She will tell you that you need to make a bowl to collect the tears, and that the only substance that can collect it is found in the rocks across the chasm. If you ask her how to cross the chasm, she will tell you the story of the [[light creature]]s and hint that they are drawn to their own colour. If you do not yet have a [[sapphire lantern]], you will need to exit the caves entirely to make it if the bullseye lantern is your only light source (see the section above).

===The Light Creatures===
[[File:Riding light creature.png|thumb|Riding a light creature.]]
Head back towards the direction you came from and climb the rocks, then click "attract" on one of the nearby light creatures. The sapphire lantern will then attract it, causing it to pick you up and transport you to the other side of the cavern where the [[magical rocks]] are.

===The Bowl===
Use your [[pickaxe]] to get a [[Magic stone (Tears of Guthix)|magic stone]], and then use your [[chisel]] to craft it into a [[stone bowl]]. One will be enough. You must have told Juna a story to be able to make the stone bowl. After this, head east and climb down the rocks to get back to Juna. Give the bowl to her to complete the quest.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

:'''Tip''': The sapphire lantern may be used again for [[While Guthix Sleeps]]. It is also possible to retrieve the sapphire by extinguishing the lantern and then using the lantern lens on it.

==Walkthrough==
[[File:The Giant Dwarf Crashing into the statue.png|thumb|220px|Crashing into the dwarf statue.]]
[[File:Dwarven Boatman chathead.png|left]]

===Property damage===
Enter the Keldagrim dungeon entrance, east of [[Rellekka]] and just south-west of [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|dks}}. After entering, continue through another cave entrance directly to the east by the statues - do '''not''' head south, as that takes you to the base of [[Trollweiss Mountain]].

Talk to the [[Dwarven Boatman]] ('''not''' the [[Dwarven Ferryman]]), who will offer you a free ride to [[Keldagrim]]. A cutscene will play, during which the boat will crash into the statue of [[King Alvis]]. After being arrested and taken to the Black Guard headquarters, [[Commander Veldaban]] will tell the player that the statue was long overdue for replacement anyway. He wants you to help out the local sculptor to rebuild the statue.

:'''''You can now use the [[Keldagrim minecart system]] throughout Gielinor.'''''

Talk to [[Blasidar the sculptor]]. He lives in the eastern side of Keldagrim, across the bridge, south of the kebab shop. He will make you the statue if you can get him clothes, an axe and boots "fit for a king". It is advisable to complete the [[The Giant Dwarf#An axe fit for a king|axe part of the quest]] last, as [[Thurgo]] will teleport the player directly to Blasidar.

===Clothes fit for a king===
{{Needed|200 [[coins]], [[coal]], [[logs]] and a [[tinderbox]]|skills={{SCP|Firemaking|16}} {{Boostable|yes}} to light the spinning machine}}

:'''Note:''' A tinderbox can be purchased from the [[general store]] on the west side of town, and coal can be mined on the east side of town.''
{{Map|name=Vermundi|2887,10188|mapID=10|r=2|mtype=square|align=left|height=200|width=200|caption=Vermundi's location}}
{{Map|name=Librarian|2862,10225|mapID=10|r=5|mtype=square|align=right|height=200|width=200|caption=The librarian's location}}
Talk to [[Vermundi]], the silk trader in the corner of the east marketplace, and ask her about making the king's clothes. She can, but first she needs a picture of the clothes. Talk to the dwarf [[librarian]] in the [[Keldagrim Library|library]] across the [[Keldagrim]] bridge. He tells you to search the library for a book about dwarven clothes. Climb any bookcase with a ladder in front of it to find the [[book on costumes]].

:'''Note:''' If you weigh 30 kg or more, you will be unable to climb the ladder. You can simply drop some items and then pick them back up.''

Give [[Vermundi]] the book. You now need to fix her steam-powered spinning machine. Use the coal on her machine with [[logs]] in your inventory, then use your tinderbox on it ({{SCP|Firemaking|16}}). If you fail to light it, just try again. Once the machine is lit, talk to her again and pay her 200 [[coins]] to get the [[exquisite clothes]].
{{Clear}}
===Boots fit for a king===
{{Needed|Means to cast [[Telekinetic Grab]] ([[Air rune|air]] and [[law rune]]).|skills={{SCP|Thieving|14}} {{Boostable|yes}} to steal the left boot, {{SCP|Magic|33}}  {{Boostable|yes}} to cast Telekinetic Grab}}

Go to the south-western [[anvil]] in [[Keldagrim]] (south of the Black Guards' HQ) and ask [[Saro]] about the boots. He sold them to [[Dromund]], another dwarf in Keldagrim. Speak to Dromund in his house just north of the bank, who will refuse to sell you the boots.

When Dromund is not looking towards you, steal the [[left boot]] from the table next to the door ({{SCP|Thieving|14|link=yes}}). The [[right boot]] is on another table, but you cannot steal it from inside the house because of his [[Dromund's cat|cat]] watching over it. Stand outside by the window with the right boot, then use [[Telekinetic Grab]] on it ({{SCP|Magic|33}}) when Dromund is not looking. Once both boots are obtained, they turn into [[Exquisite boots]].

===An axe fit for a king===
{{Needed|An [[iron bar]], 3 [[sapphire]]s, and a [[redberry pie]] (if you have not given [[Thurgo]] a free redberry pie in the past, with the required redberry pies for [[The Knight's Sword]] and [[Prying Times]] not counting).|skills={{SCP|Crafting|12}} {{Boostable|yes}} to attach sapphires to the hilt}}
{{Map|name=Santiri|2828,10231|height=200|width=200|rectX=11|rectY=9|zoom=2|mapID=10|mtype=rectangle|align=left|caption=Santiri's location}}
{{Map|name=Thurgo|3001,3144|height=200|width=250|r=2|mtype=square|align=right|caption=Thurgo's location}}
Talk to [[Santiri]], the tradesman of the [[Quality Weapons Shop|sword shop]] in north-west [[Keldagrim]]. He talks about how his family came to possess the [[Dwarven battleaxe]], mentioning it has been damaged and that the [[sapphire]]s on the hilt had either been stolen or washed away. During the dialogue where you offer to repair the axe, Santiri may note your mastery of [[Smithing]] but exclaims that even you aren't skilled enough. 

After he gives you the axe, use three sapphires on it to rebuild the hilt ({{SCP|Crafting|12}}). Talk to Santiri again, who says that only an [[Imcando dwarf]] could fully repair it.

If you have completed [[The Knight's Sword]], the player will remark that they know an Imcando dwarf. If you have not completed it, you will need to first talk to the dwarf [[librarian]] in the [[Keldagrim Library|library]] by the [[Keldagrim]] bridge. They will tell the player to speak to [[Reldo]] in the [[Varrock Palace]] library to discover [[Thurgo]]'s location; this is necessary to progress.

Thurgo resides in the single house at [[Mudskipper Point]], south-east of [[Rimmington]] and south of [[Port Sarim]]. The fastest way to get there is to travel using [[Fairy rings]] to {{Fairycode|AIQ}}. Go to him with an [[iron bar]], and ask him to repair the axe. After that, if you have not yet given him a [[redberry pie]] for '''free''' previously, you must give him one now. He will then repair the axe.

:'''''Note:''' Thurgo will supply you with another axe if lost, but it will require three sapphires to be added again.''

When Thurgo is done, you have the option to return immediately to Keldagrim. This will place you back in [[Blasidar the sculptor]]'s house.

===The Head===
Give [[Riki the sculptor's model|Riki]] the axe, clothes and boots by speaking to him with the items in your inventory. Talk to [[Blasidar the sculptor|Blasidar]], who explains that the Consortium wants the head of the statue modelled after one of its directors, but has not agreed which one. He asks you to go and help them make a decision. You will see a short cutscene of the incomplete statue.

:'''Make sure to complete this step before starting the tasks below, or the tasks for the director will go on indefinitely!'''

===Joining the consortium===
There are eight mining companies in the [[Consortium]], which are located upstairs in either the east or west marketplace:
*[[The Green Gemstone]]
*[[The White Chisel]]
*[[The Silver Cog]]
*[[The Brown Engine]]
*[[The Yellow Fortune]]
*[[The Blue Opal]]
*[[The Purple Pewter]]
*[[The Red Axe]] ''(you cannot join this company)''

You will need to pick a company to join. Joining [[The Purple Pewter]] provides a headstart of 20 points in the scoring system by speaking to the [[Purple Pewter Secretary]] whilst wearing three or more pieces of the [[H.A.M. robes]] set. Otherwise, your choice will only impact the [[Giant Dwarf (statue)|final model of the statue]] built at the end of the quest.

The companies on the west side of the building have faster bank access, whilst the east side is closer to the [[Ore seller.|ore seller]] and Grand Exchange (through minecart).

To begin, talk to the secretary of the company that you want to work for. You will be given several errands to collect 3-5 of a certain ''un-noted'' material within a time limit (10 minutes, plus an extra minute per item requested). The possible items are [[clay]], [[copper ore]], [[tin ore]], [[iron ore]], [[silver ore]], [[gold ore]], [[mithril ore]], and [[coal]]. With the exception of clay, all materials can be mined or bought nearby, if they are not already in your bank or inventory. You can say "no," then talk to the secretary again to receive a different task.

A hidden scoring system determines your progress with a company; each ore delivery completed gives 20 points, while failing or cancelling a task subtracts 2 points. '''Progress is not shared between companies, so only perform tasks for one of them.'''

:'''Note:''' If you fail a task and are unable to obtain a new one, logging out and logging back in should fix the issue.

Once you reach 75 points, you will be told that the director of the company wants to speak with you. At this point you may start doing errands for the director, who will request different items from you. These items include [[bronze bars]], [[iron bars]], [[steel bars]], [[silver bars]], [[gold bars]], and [[mithril bars]], and give 12 points. They also request a lower quantity of these items, being 2-4 rather than 3-5, and extra time is given (10 minutes plus 2 extra minutes per item requested).

When you have have obtained 100 points for a company, you can ask the director to officially join them, and they will agree and accept you as a "trusted associate". Next, tell them that [[Blasidar the sculptor|Blasidar]] sent you, and that you will vouch for them at the next Consortium meeting.

===Art by committee===
Return to [[Commander Veldaban]] (west of the bank) and tell him you will go to the meeting. You will see a cutscene of about 4 minutes. You can also skip the cutscene by refusing to go to the meeting; you can read a summary of it in the [[meeting notes]], received after completing the quest.

==Trivia==
* The cutscene between the Consortium leaders at the end of the quest takes place in a static, non-instanced room; a glimpse of one of these rooms can be seen during normal gameplay from the third room of [[Pyramid Plunder]]. This is because at the time of the quest's development, Jagex was unable to create [[instance]]d areas for cutscenes, even though [[The Lost Tribe]], another quest released on the same day but went into development later than The Giant Dwarf, was the first use of an instance in the game.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1162261891537707008|date=16 August 2019|archiveurl=https://archive.fo/19tgw|archivedate=16 August 2019|quote=Sort of. Before developers could generate instanced copies of areas on demand, cutscenes had to take place in static copies of the map, and you're seeing one of those.}}{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1644084798091153411|date=16 August 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/96343|archivedate=8 April 2023|quote=Yeah, Giant Dwarf went into development considerably earlier, being a bigger project due to the city being created as part of it. By the time Lost Tribe went into development, instances were available to be used. Mod Vincent would otherwise have appreciated them!}}
** As a result, there are sixteen distinct cutscene rooms (four for each floor the game possesses) in which the player can be assigned to. If a seventeenth player attempts to enter a cutscene whilst all sixteen cutscene rooms are occupied, [[Commander Veldaban]] will tell the player that the Consortium either has "other important business to attend to", or that the meeting hasn't started yet. The exact conditions to what he says can be found in the [[Transcript:The Giant Dwarf#Talking to Commander Veldaban|quest's transcript]].
*There was a graphical glitch that appeared during the cutscenes that shows a closeup up the Giant Dwarf statue: the body appeared to be floating above the legs, and the head (once it had been added) was floating above the body.
*If you talk to Dromund's Cat while wearing a catspeak amulet, he mentions he used to be friends with the Red Axe cat.
*When telling the player to pay for the clothes, [[Vermundi]] asks for "200 credits." This is the only place in the game where [[coins]] are referred to as ''credits''.
*When asking Santiri about battleaxes, he offers you a blue or red one, saying "red is on the rise". This is a reference to the name of the quest series, Rise of the Red Axe.
*When speaking to Santiri about repairing the axe, his dialogue changes depending on your smithing level. For example, if the player has 99 Smithing. "The axe is beyond repair, even for a master such as you."
*Near the beginning of the meeting, Hreidmar interrupts the argument by saying 'This bickering is pointless'. This is likely a reference to Governor Tarkin in ''{{Wp|Star Wars: Episode IV – A New Hope}}''.
*Completing The Giant Dwarf quest before choosing the statue's head in the [[Enakhra's Lament]] quest unlocks additional dialogue with [[Lazim]].
*The models of some of the dwarves are [[:File:Yellow Fortune Director (cutscene).png|glitched]] in the end cutscene due to a specific broken animation they perform.

{{Listen |title = [[Captain Braindeath (Rum Deal)|Captain Braindeath]] |align = left |filename = Captain Braindeath (Rum Deal).ogg |desc = The jingle that plays while Pirate Pete speaks to Captain Braindeath.}} Talk to [[Pirate Pete]] at the dock north-east of the [[Ectofuntus]] to start the quest. Pirate Pete claims to be a dispossessed nobleman who needs to reclaim his family sword in order to defeat his evil half-brother, who has stolen his lands and is now terrorizing the local lemon farmers. Agree to help him, after which he will warn you about his brother's dangerous ally, the demon Barrelor the Destroyer. Agree nonetheless; Pete will explain his half-brother has stolen most of his fortune, but he will gladly part with what remains for your help. Refuse the money he offers you. He will instruct you to pick up a diversion, knock you out and row you to a secret location. A cutscene ensues in which Pete delivers you, tied up and unconscious, to a worried pirate captain, revealing that the entire story was fabricated. Upon awakening, you will find yourself in a small room with the captain, who will explain that you are in the brewery on the secret [[Braindeath Island]]. He introduces himself as [[Captain Braindeath]], and explains that a week ago the island came under siege of a group of [[Zombie pirate (Braindeath Island)|zombie pirates]] protesting. He needs to make some 'rum' in order to get the protesters' leader [[Captain Donnie]] drunk, after which Braindeath and his brewers can sneak out of the factory and set up a new brewery elsewhere. You will have to gather the ingredients to make the rum. Braindeath will give you a [[Blindweed seed|seed]] in order to grow the first ingredient, [[blindweed]]. He explains the [[zombie swab]]s have trashed the previous blindweed patches, but that intimidation should be sufficient to get rid of them. {{clear}}[[File:Rum Deal protestors.png|thumb|280x280px|Zombies protesting outside the brewery.]] {{Listen |title = [[Rum for the Dumb (Rum Deal)|Rum for the Dumb]] |align = right |filename = Rum for the Dumb (Rum Deal).ogg |desc = The jingle that plays as the cutscene pans to the protesting zombies.}} ===Brewing "rum"=== ====Blindweed==== [[File:Rum Deal - kitten censor.png|thumb|220px|"We interrupt this insult to bring you this soothing picture of a kitten. Normal service will be resumed shortly. Thank you for your patience."]]{{Needed|[[Rake]] and [[seed dibber]].}} If you don't have the rake and seed dibber yet, go down the ladder in the north-west corner of the building to the basement, and then head south-east past the spiders to find a [[cupboard (Rum Deal)|cupboard]]. There, take the rake and seed dibber from the cupboard. Leave the building by the southernmost stairway, towards the [[farming patches]]. You may be attacked by [[zombie swab]]s; walk out of combat and right-click to "Intimidate" them, which permanently stops them from attacking you. A picture of a kitten will be shown to censor your insults. The only usable farming patch is the south-eastern one. Use your rake on the patch to remove the weeds and then plant the seed (requires {{SCP|Farming|40|link=yes}}). '''''Note:''''' If you have grabbed more then one seed by drop trick this will plant all of them in the stack, once planted you will be unable to get more. Wait a few minutes for the blindweed to grow; you will receive the notification "''I wonder how my blindweed is coming along...''". Harvest the crop. '''''Note:''' Should you lose the blindweed after this, Braindeath will give you some he had in storage all along.'' [[File:Rum Deal Hopper.png|thumb|220px|The hopper is in the north-west corner.]] Return to [[Captain Braindeath]], who will tell you to put the blindweed in the hopper upstairs. Use the south-eastern ladder to climb upstairs and then use the blindweed on the hopper in the north-western corner of the room. You can ignore the lever for now. Talk to Captain Braindeath for the next ingredient; [[stagnant water]]. ====Stagnant water==== {{Needed|[[Bucket]].}} Braindeath will hand you a [[bucket]] unless you already have one. You will have to travel to a nearby volcano and fill the [[bucket]] with the stagnant water. Leave the house via the south stairway again and exit the outside fence, then travel north-west to find [[50% Luke]] guarding a small gate (you may equip the [[Ring of Charos(a)]] or use a [[tinderbox]] on him for some amusing dialogue). Pass the gate behind him and travel up the volcano to collect the stagnant water. Return to the house, pour the water into the hopper, and talk to [[Captain Braindeath]]. ====Sluglings==== Braindeath will give you a [[Fishbowl and net|fishbowl tangled in a big net]]. '''''Note:''' If you untangle the fishbowl and net, you have to use them on each other to re-tangle them.'' Head to the [[fishing spots]] near the farming patch you used earlier. You have to catch a total of FIVE (5) [[sluglings]] or [[karamthulhu]] and add them to the pressure barrel upstairs in the building, next to the hopper. Pull the lever, and the brewing control apparatus downstairs will start to spin and shake uncontrollably. Return to [[Captain Braindeath]]. ====Evil spirits==== [[File:Holy wrench blessing.png|thumb|220px|Blessing the wrench.]] The captain will tell you that the controls for the brewery have become possessed, which "occasionally happens". He will give you a wrench in order to beat the controls with it, but remarks that it requires a blessing first for the possessing spirit to come out. Head to the west side of the house and get your wrench blessed by former priest [[Davey]]. He will only bless the wrench if you have 47 or more '''available [[prayer points]]'''. ''Note that this does '''not''' drain any prayer points.'' Now, beat up the controls with the [[holy wrench]]. They are located directly south of Captain Braindeath. As soon as you hit the controls, a level 150 [[Evil spirit]] will appear and attack you. His attacks can be negated with [[Protect from Melee]], or by using a [[safespot]] with [[Ranged]], [[Magic]], or a [[halberd]]. ====Fever spider==== {{Needed|recommended=Means to deal damage at range ([[Magic]], [[Ranged]] or a [[Halberd]]) '''or''' means to negate [[disease]] (such as [[Slayer gloves]] or a [[Relicym's balm]]).}} Having defeated the evil spirit, Captain Braindeath will tell you that the final ingredient is the carcass of a diseased [[fever spider]]. You must complete the dialogue with him or the carcass will not drop! Go down the nearby ladder into the basement and kill a fever spider. Be warned that fever spiders inflict [[disease]] on hit, even with [[Protect from Melee]]; you can circumvent this by using a [[safespot]] or having [[slayer gloves]] equipped, or using a cure such as [[Relicym's balm]]. Collect its carcass, use it on the hopper, and return to Captain Braindeath. Note that killing the fever spider completes a [[Morytania Diary#Medium|medium Morytania Diary]] task. '''Note''': Disease is cured upon completing the quest. Rum Deal farming.png|Sowing some blindweed amidst the terrified zombie crew of The Inebriated. ===Starting Out===
{{Needed|[[Silverlight]], 3 items of black clothing (see below), an [[empty vial]] and [[pestle and mortar]] to make [[black dye]], transport to the [[Ruins of Uzer]] (e.g. [[necklace of passage]]; or [[ring of dueling]], [[Shantay pass (item)|Shantay pass]] and 200 [[coins]])}}

Talk to [[Father Reen]], south of [[Al Kharid]] bank. If you do not have a regular [[Silverlight]], he will give you an uncoloured Silverlight free of charge. '''If you already have a dyed Silverlight, bank the extra Silverlight. If this dialogue is missed, Silverlight can still be obtained at other points in the quest by speaking to him.''' 

After you start, travel to the [[Ruins of Uzer]] (you can enter the desert via the [[Shantay Pass]] and use the [[magic carpet]], rub a [[necklace of passage]] to Eagles' Eyrie and run south-east or travel with [[fairy ring|fairy rings]] to {{Fairycode|DLQ}} and run north-east). Be sure to bring your Silverlight with you since you won't be able to continue without it. After arriving in Uzer, talk to [[Father Badden]] - be sure to talk to him about all your options. If you haven't already, pick a black mushroom. Afterwards, enter the dungeon.

When you try to enter the demon's lair, [[Evil Dave]] won't let you by because you aren't evil enough.
You need to wear at least three items of black clothing. There are several ways to achieve this, including:
[[File:Shadow of the Storm - black mushrooms.png|thumb|220px|A black mushroom near the entrance.]]

*Dyeing a [[desert shirt]] and a [[desert robe]] black by picking a [[black mushroom]] outside of the dungeon and crafting it into [[black dye]] with a [[vial]] and [[pestle and mortar]], for two of the three items (does not work on the [[desert boots]]).
*Wearing any three [[black armour]] items. The [[black gloves]] available from the [[Culinaromancer's Chest]] also function as a black armour item (although this quest must be completed in order to finish the [[Freeing Evil Dave|Evil Dave part]] of Recipe for Disaster) '''Note:''' Wearing heraldic or trimmed black armour items will not be accepted by Evil Dave.
*Wearing a black [[priest gown]] purchased from the [[Thessalia|clothing vendor]] in [[Varrock]].
*Wearing [[Mystic robes#Dark|dark mystic robes]].
*Wearing [[ghostly robes]] from the [[Curse of the Empty Lord]] miniquest.
*Wearing [[shade robes]].
*Wearing [[black dragonhide armour]], including the [[Black d'hide shield|shield]], but not the [[Black spiky vambraces|spiky vambraces]].
*Wearing the [[Antisanta outfit]].
*Wearing a [[black cape]], [[black partyhat]], [[black santa hat]], [[black h'ween mask]], [[black dragon mask]], and/or a [[black unicorn mask]]
*Wearing black [[wizard robes]], including either trimmed varieties (blue varieties can be dyed with [[Black dye]]).
*Wearing a [[graceful outfit]] which has been recoloured using [[dark dye]].
