==Walkthrough==
===Infiltration II===
{{Needed|Two empty inventory spaces, emissary robes, combat gear for a fight with prayer disabled|recommended=[[Pendant of Ates]], equip all spots not worn by the emissary robes}}
[[File:The Final Dawn - meeting with the Queen.png|thumb|250px|The player meets with Queen Zyanyi.]]
Speak to [[Servius, Teokan of Ralos]] at the {{floor|uk=0}} of the [[Sunrise Palace]]. He will tell you that [[Queen Zyanyi Arkan]] seeks an audience with you; accept to start the quest.

A cutscene will begin in which you will be brought to the top of the palace, with the Queen asking you about your involvement with [[Prince Itzla Arkan]], even though it meant disobeying direct orders from her. You admit that you helped him regardless of the consequences, but you offer to atone for your mistake. Servius convinces her to do so, and she decides to let the incident slide by proving yourself. She asks you to infiltrate the [[Twilight Emissaries]] and see what they're up to. Make sure to bring your emissary robes.
[[File:The Final Dawn - Metzli sermon.png|thumb|250px|Metzli presents Prince Itzla before the cultists.]]
Head back to the [[Twilight Temple]] ([[quetzal]] to [[Salvager Overlook]] then running south to the temple will be fastest), and head inside whilst wearing your [[Twilight Emissary robes]], and another cutscene will play as [[Metzli]] reveals to the cultists that they have Prince Itzla captive. Itzla is defiant in front of the crowd before he is taken away, seemingly underground. After the cutscene, attempt to go downstairs; you will be stopped by a [[Emissary Ascended]] asking you for the passcode, which is "Final Dawn".

:'''Note''': While in the basement you will be unable to unequip your robes.  Logging out may return you to the ground floor, and logging out or teleporting out can remove any quest items collected there.

Once in the basement, go north and then east into an offshoot. You will need to make your way past the [[Emissary Enforcer]], who will throw you out if he sees you or you are too close behind him. Once you sneak past him, head into the next room, where you will try to get information on Itzla's whereabouts. When Metzli and Furia walk out of a room, the latter is concerned about the former's reckless actions before they leave.

Search the bed from the room they came out of for a [[Key (The Final Dawn)|key]], and then search the drawer with the key to obtain a [[canvas piece]]. There are two drawers; one in the north and another in the south, and the location of the canvas is different for every player. Use the piece on the [[Painting (Twilight Temple)|painting]], then attempt to pick the lock on the chest inside.

To open the chest, simply move the tumblers by clicking on slots above them. The fastest way to brute force the lock is to simply click confirm, see if any show up as green on the right, and if not, move everything up by one. This will take no more than eight tries for the final combination. When picking the chest, if a number is blue, that means it is used in the combination but on a different tumbler. Once you picklock the chest, you will obtain an [[emissary scroll]] and attempt to leave, only for the enforcer to walk in and spot you. He will take the scroll from you before attempting to kill you for your betrayal.
[[File:The Final Dawn - fighting Emissary Enforcer.png|thumb|250px|The player side-steps the Emissary Enforcer in time.]]
The enforcer has 180 hitpoints and uses a 3x3 AoE melee attack centred on himself. Periodically, he will yell a random quote (such as {{overhead|Thief!}} or {{overhead|Traitor!}}) and lunge forward, dealing moderate damage if caught in it and also having a chance to apply a [[bleed]]. In other words, all of his attacks are avoidable as long as players react to them in time by running away or side-stepping him. The player is unable to change their equipment during the fight, so it is highly recommended to have equipped the necessary gear beforehand. Additionally, players cannot use prayers or teleport out, though escape is possible via right-clicking "Quick-escape" on the exit door. Should players die during this fight, their gravestone will be placed at the entrance to the Twilight Temple.

After the enforcer dies, pick up the emissary scroll, read it, and then return to the [[Sunrise Palace]].

===Home Invasion===
{{Needed|One of the following: bones, raw meat, cooked meat}}
Make your way to the top floor of the [[Sunrise Palace]], and inform Queen Zyanyi of the scroll's contents, which reveal that [[Forebearer Janus]] intends to move into a newly acquired property across from a bank as a safe house for the cult. Servius immediately recognises this bank as the south-western bank of Civitas illa Fortis, since there are no houses around the eastern bank. Zyanyi will have [[Captain Vibia]] help you capture Janus, asking you to meet up with her at the safe house, where she will ask you to set up the trap.

Head over to the safe house, Captain Vibia will be located on the road just south of the building. After talking to her, interact with the south-eastern window and force it open, then climb through the window. A [[Gus#Dog (alert)|dog]] inside will become agitated and attack; use either a pile of [[bones]], or a raw/[[cooked meat]] of any sort to calm it down; [[raw beast meat]] or [[raw mystery meat]] will not work. Pet the dog to see its nametag, which is "GUS". This is the code needed to unlock the door to the rest of the house, and you will bring Vibia in after the coast is clear.

You will now need to make preparations to capture Janus whenever he arrives. First, grab the [[knife]] in the kitchen, then the sack of potatoes just outside the kitchen. Empty the sack, then head upstairs and grab the [[coin purse]] lying there. Open the purse, then head up to the top floor and use the knife on the potted fan plant with a lighter shade of green for a [[Branch (The Final Dawn)|branch]]. Additionally, use the now-empty coin purse on the pot of sand for a [[sandy coin purse]], then lastly use the branch on it to create a [[makeshift blackjack]].
[[File:The Final Dawn - interrogating Janus.png|thumb|250px|The Queen discusses what she learned from Janus, who has recently departed to the afterlife.]]
With the sack and blackjack, return to Captain Vibia, and a cutscene will ensue where Janus enters the house and discovers you and Vibia before you knock him out with the blackjack and Vibia restrains him with the sack. Search him for a key, then enter the basement for another cutscene. Zyanyi and her entourage will arrive to confront Janus, who is defiant towards her and states that he is not afraid of death. Zyanyi asks you and the others to leave while she makes him talk. The screen fades to black while various sounds of an unarmed man being assaulted can be heard.

Shortly after, the group returns, and Janus is found dead on the floor, with Zyanyi having tortured and interrogated him. Zyanyi reveals that the cult really intends to perform the Gathering, a ritual in which a dead Teokan is laid to rest and a successor chosen. While you question this, Zyanyi states that they intend to perform this ritual at the [[Crypt of Tonali]] in the [[Tlati Rainforest]], where a set of doors must be opened with the blood of two Teokan, and beyond said doors is where the cult believes the path to Mokhaiotl lies.

However, without Servius, the cult hopes to use Prince Itzla's blood instead, and has sought help from the Dwarves of [[Cam Torum]], as they were the ones who had built the doors. You will be offered to depart with them (acting as a "teleport" to the city). Accept this offer to initiate another cutscene.

===Dwarven Traitor===
[[File:The Final Dawn - meeting with Highlord Katlo.png|thumb|250px|Highlord Katlo, who oversees Cam Torum, greets the Queen and her group.]]
On the way to [[Cam Torum]], [[Highlord Katlo]] and [[Attala]] will arrive to greet the group. Zyanyi will explain the reason for their visit and asks to lead an investigation, but Katlo refuses, believing a human investigation within his city would cause friction between the dwarven citizens and the human presence. However, [[Attala]] will vouch for you given your previous assistance during the events of [[Perilous Moons]], and Highlord Katlo will grant the group permission to search for the cultists. Attala will ask you to meet her in the market, while Queen Zyanyi heads to [[Tal Teklan]] to prepare the defences at the [[Crypt of Tonali]]. Servius will accompany you, knowing that he is not safe anywhere and may have some knowledge to contribute towards the investigation.

Head further inside, and Attala will question Servius' presence, though you stop their arguing. Attala explains that only four individuals are authorised to grant human access to Cam Torum: Highlord Katlo, herself, Highseer Vandra, and her advisor [[Teumo]]. Attala believes that Teumo is the likeliest suspect, as she has enough trust in Katlo and Vandra, and asks you to meet her and Servius at Teumo's home.

Teumo's house is just east of the bank; enter it, where you will meet [[Galna]]. Attala will claim that Teumo allowed them to help with a project, while Galna allows the three of you to stay but avoid going downstairs, as she claims Teumo doesn't like anyone going down there. Go upstairs, grab the [[beer]] on the table, then speak to Galna again. Offer the beer to her, which she will chug and get drunk, allowing you to go wherever you want.

[[File:Drink Placement Puzzle.png|thumb|250px|The placement of drinks to extinguish the fireplace.]]

Go downstairs and search the cabinet to the south-west and grab one of each of the following beverages: [[steamforge brew]], [[dwarven stout]], beer, and [[wizard's mind bomb]]. You will need to place these on the barrels around the area.
* Place the steamforge brew on the barrel directly south of the cabinet (indicated with "steam")
* Place the stout directly east of this barrel (indicated with "black liquid")
* Place the beer on the northern barrel (indicated with "smells like a Gielinorian pub")
* Place the mind bomb on the south-eastern barrel (indicated with "bubbling")
* Drink any beer from the cabinet, then place the remaining [[beer glass]] on the original regular beer barrel ("This barrel seems to be empty").

Once the last correct drink is placed, you will hear a click and the fireplace will extinguish, revealing a lever. Pull the lever, then head to the south-east room and go through the hole. A cutscene will play where you eavesdrop the Tullus twins talking with [[Teumo]], who agrees to help them open the doors in the [[Crypt of Tonali]], provided that they retrieve an [[Old One]] [[keystone]] from [[Neypotzli]], which he needs to succeed in getting the doors opened.

Report the news back to Servius and Attala, revealing that Teumo was bribed by the cult for his assistance, and you will tell Servius to head to Tal Teklan to see if the defences are ready, while Attala gets the guards to deal with Teumo. Attala will tell you to go to Neypotzli.

===Interlopers in Neypotzli===
{{Needed|Combat equipment (preferably melee or ranged), one empty slot}}
Retrieve combat equipment and optionally supplies at the [[Cam Torum bank]]. The arena the upcoming fight takes place in is considered a part of Neypotzli, meaning that [[moonlight potion]]s and [[cooked bream]]/[[cooked moss lizard]] can be made and used as free supplies for the fight. Melee or ranged is preferred for the fight due to Lucius' high magic level giving him strong magic defences. Make your way north to [[Neypotzli]]. As you enter, [[Eyatlalli]] will appear before you, telling you of interlopers tampering with the [[Monolith (Neypotzli)|icosahedron]] behind her. She will tell you that it is a form of keystone, and that an earlier form of it remains from when the prison was built. As she must keep the [[Moons of Peril]] in check, she cannot stop them from obtaining it, though you offer to do so in her stead. She will give you a [[keystone fragment]] to locate the other keystone. Before you leave, you will ask about Mokhaiotl. Eyatlalli states that while she was created near the end of the Old Ones' time, she did hear the word at least once, and believes that it was related to hope.
[[File:The Final Dawn - confronting the twins in Neypotzli.png|thumb|250px|The player confronts the Tullus twins in Neypotzli.]]
Head through each chamber, using the keystone to pinpoint the exact tile to resonate with the key. You will need to do this once in both the Streambound and Earthbound Caverns. If no supplies were brought, also make some potions and food in these caverns to prepare for the upcoming fight. Then head to the Ancient Prison and use the key in the room to the south-east in the section, revealing a [[glowing symbol]]. Go through it, and a cutscene ensues where you confront the Tullus twins, who have already retrieved the keystone. Ennius will call in Metzli, who teleports the twins out and orders [[Lucius]] and [[Chimalli]] to kill you.
[[File:The Final Dawn - fighting Lucius and Chimalli.png|thumb|250px|The player fights Lucius and Chimalli. Chimalli is performing her special attack.]]
For the fight, auto-retaliate should be turned off to avoid being dragged into danger. The two cultists have 180 health. Lucius uses magic, while Chimalli uses ranged. They will attack off-sync, allowing the player to flick against their attacks, and it is recommended to do so as they can hit fairly hard. Every three attacks, Lucius will unleash a triple projectile while a 2x2 mini-sun in the arena appears as a safespot. Failing to be in this zone before the projectile hits will deal heavy damage and disable protection prayers. Meanwhile, Chimalli will unleash a barrage of fire arrows that can be avoided by running away from where they would land, indicated with glowing shadows. When one of the pair dies, the other will enter an enraged state; their attacks will pierce through prayer (dealing chip damage), and they will use their special attack more often. It is recommended to kill Lucius first, since Chimalli's special attack is much easier to avoid, especially if you are using melee for the fight. 

When the last of the cultists dies, Attala and a few guards will arrive. You will tell her that the twins managed to escape with the keystone, and she will tell you in turn that they failed to find Teumo. You ask if Cam Torum will aid the Queen, but Attala states that this is a human matter and of no threat to Cam Torum, and as such, will not intervene; however, she does hope you survive before leaving to inform Highlord Katlo of the situation.

===Crypt Assault===
{{Needed|Combat equipment of any style for fighting cultists, melee combat equipment for Ennius Tullus, food, potions}}
[[File:The Final Dawn - defending the Crypt.png|thumb|250px|Defending the Crypt against the cultist's assault.]]
Head to [[Tal Teklan]] and find Servius, who is by the eastern gate. He will tell you that the cultists are attacking the [[Crypt of Tonali]]. Run south-east; you will find the cultists fighting the Tonali archers and warriors outside the crypt as Queen Zyanyi leads the defence to prevent them from charging through.

You will face six waves of cultists (Emissary [[Emissary Brawler|brawlers]], [[Emissary Archer|archers]], and [[Emissary Conjurer|conjurers]]), alongside Queen Zyanyi (level 144), Captain Vibia (level 128), and two Tonali warriors and archers (level 85). While a few more Tonali and some of the [[Kualti]] are fighting them a bit further down, they are simply there as scenery.
*'''Wave 1:''' 2x Emissary Brawler (level 74), 2x Emissary Brawler (level 86)
*'''Wave 2:''' 2x Emissary Brawler (level 74), 1x Emissary Brawler (level 86)
*'''Wave 3:''' 1x Emissary Brawler (level 74), 1x Emissary Brawler (level 86), 1x Emissary Archer (level 71)
*'''Wave 4:''' 1x Emissary Brawler (level 74), 1x Emissary Brawler (level 86), 1x Emissary Archer (level 71), 1x Emissary Conjurer (level 71)
*'''Wave 5:''' 2x Emissary Brawler (level 74), 1x Emissary Brawler (level 86), 1x Emissary Archer (level 71), 1x Emissary Conjurer (level 71)
*'''Wave 6:''' 2x Emissary Brawler (level 86), 2x Emissary Conjurer (level 71)
[[File:The Final Dawn - Crypt doors opened.png|thumb|250px|The Crypt's doors are successfully opened.]]
The next wave starts when one enemy from the previous wave remains. While the cultists initially target the Tonali, the player can draw their aggression by attacking them, or may restore hitpoints to the Tonali using food. If too many Tonali fall, the battle is lost, and players must restart from the beginning. 

The cultists can run, but they don't use routefinding, so the Emissary Brawlers can be trapped behind fires in the room allowing them to be [[safespot|safespotted]]. The [[Emissary Archer|archers]] and [[Emissary Conjurer|conjurers]] cannot be safespotted due to their higher attack range.

After the last wave of cultists is slain, another group will barge in. Additionally, [[Metzli, Teokan of Ranul|Metzli]], the Tullus twins ([[Furia Tullus|Furia]] and [[Ennius Tullus|Ennius]]), [[Teumo]], and [[Prince Itzla]] are all teleported into the crypt by a conjurer. Teumo activates the door and walks off, while the others, barring Itzla, rush inside. Zyanyi will get her son and order him away to recover, telling you to come with her to chase after the leaders.

===Tullus Showdown===
[[File:The Final Dawn - fighting Ennius.png|thumb|250px|Ennius unleashes his Sunfire Blast.]]
Pursuing the leaders to a small platform, you, Zyanyi, and Vibia confront the Tullus twins, with Furia realising that Metzli had deceived them, though Ennius fails to do so. Furia also reveals that she only accepted Metzli's offer as she promised to return the throne to the Tullus family, which had been seized from them after [[Emperor Imafore]]'s death. Zyanyi offers them a chance to surrender, but Ennius will refuse and instead draws out his sword and casts several fire spells around the area, separating Vibia and Furia, leaving you and Zyanyi to fight Ennius.

Ennius will have both [[Protect from Magic]] and [[Protect from Missiles]] active simultaneously, so players must use melee to harm him. He has 380 hitpoints and attacks with melee, along with a few special attacks:
* '''Sunfire Blast:''' Circles will begin glowing around the area, indicating safespots for his upcoming attack. Getting caught in this attack will deal moderate damage and inflict a weak [[burn]].
* '''Sunfire Strike:''' A row or column of sunfire through him. Getting caught in this attack will deal moderate damage and inflict a weak burn. If the player is diagonally across, he will likewise launch one across himself.
* '''Sunfire Smite:''' Ennius will disable the player's overhead prayers.

It is recommended to have auto-retaliate off to prevent your character from walking back into a special attack danger zone. Queen Zyanyi will usually react to the special attacks, showing you how to deal with them. Upon reaching 0 health, Ennius will empower himself, yelling {{overhead|The sun burns within me!}}, entering the enrage phase. He will heal for 120 health, attacks significantly faster, pierces prayer slightly more, and the Sunfire Strike is enhanced to cover three rows/columns at a time. A halberd weapon can be useful in attacking diagonally across to minimise time loss.

Upon reaching 0 health a second time, Ennius will die for good, while Vibia informs the two of you that Furia was injured but managed to run away. Prince Itzla will then appear in his combat gear and insist that he accompany you in pursuing Furia and Metzli. Queen Zyanyi will initially refuse, but is persuaded to remain at the Crypt entrance to defend against the cultists.

===The Tonali Cavern===
{{Needed|A knife blade (found in pile of Old Tools), 3 free inventory spaces for the [[knife blade]], [[ancient roots]], and [[root kindling]]}}

You will need to navigate through the underground cavern beneath the Crypt. A [[Earthen Nagua]] will appear, prompting Prince Itzla to stay behind and fight it while telling you to go further ahead. Make your way across the agility shortcuts or portals to reach the other end of the chamber, where you will find a rope leading to a bridge. Climb the rope and head north to meet Prince Itzla, who has caught up to you. Make sure to activate the strange platform, as this unlocks a permanent shortcut to the surface.

Upon entering the next room, you will find both a moon and sun puzzle to the sides, both of which need to be solved to proceed further in. Avoid logging out or hopping worlds during the puzzles, as this may reset your progress.

====Sun Chamber====
The right side of the room contains a sun-related puzzle. Inspect the statue, which is written in the Old Ones' language. Speak to Prince Itzla and ask him to translate the words for you by inputting them into the message box when prompted.

In order to activate the statue, both you and Prince Itzla must be at a specific altar and imbue it with [[Kuhu essence]], found by searching the urns near the altars.
[[File:Final dawn clock.png|alt=The numbered altars for the clock puzzle|thumb|The numbers corresponding to the clock altars.]]
The altars are not labeled or numbered in any way in game, but their numbering starts with 1 being the north-east altar and travels clockwise, with 8 ending at the north altar.

The statue's wording will determine where you and Prince Itzla need to be positioned, and is random for every player. You will need to be on one altar corresponding to either the first or second numbered altar of the statue's given code, while Prince Itzla would be moved to the altar of the second altar number, respectively. The third number/word is not used (but is good for translation purposes).

* Oma = 2
* Naui = 4
* Kuli = 5
* Chaki = 6
* Koma = 7
* Ueai = 8
* Makti = 10

For example, if the statue states "Naui Koma-Makti", you or Itzla need to be placed by the fourth altar, while the other needs to go to the seventh altar. The altars are numbered 1 to 8, with the first being the north-east altar and the next number in sequence going clockwise. 

When placed on the correct altar, attempt to imbue the Kuhu essence. If successful, the statue will generate a new phrase. If failed, you will take 5 damage. After three successful tries, the room is finished.

====Moon Chamber====
The left side of the room contains a moon-related puzzle. You will be teleported to the north end of the room, while Prince Itzla is teleported into the centre. Flames block your path forward. Itzla can disable them by standing on the corresponding platform - Northern for dark blue, Southern for light blue. You will need to move him between the two platforms to disable the flames in turn as you traverse the room.

At multiple places on the floor leading to the statue, there are [[old tools]] and tree roots. Search the old tools to get a [[knife blade]] (you only need one). Pull the tree roots to get [[ancient roots]]. Use the knife blade to on the ancient roots to fletch them into [[root kindling]]. Each ancient root yields 4 root kindling. Before inspecting the statue, have Prince Itzla move back and forth between the two platforms, and count the total number of braziers that light up. This is how much kindling you will need.

Inspect the statue and place the required amount of kindling on it. Putting the wrong amount onto it will cause the player to take 4-5 damage. Repeat this process two more times, counting the braziers and depositing the kindling. After three successful deposits, the room is finished.

===The Truth of Mokhaiotl===
{{Needed|Combat equipment (preferably ranged), food, potions}}
Head into the next chamber to find [[Augur Metzli|Metzli]], who reveals that she manipulated the cult to acquire the means to access Mokhaiotl, which she knows is an archive built by the [[Old Ones]]. She will then initiate combat, entering a ranged form. Immediately activate Protect from Missiles and fight her. Metzli has 600 hitpoints, and Prince Itzla will assist you in the fight. It is recommended to fight her using ranged since her magic defence is fairly high and many of her mechanics must be dodged.
[[File:The Final Dawn - fighting Metzli.png|thumb|250px|The player and Prince Itzla confront Metzli.]]
Every three attacks, Metzli will perform a special attack based on her current active style:
*'''Sunfire Blast:''' Same as the one used by Ennius, except used twice in a row.
*'''Sunfire Waves:''' Metzli will unleash two waves of sunfire that sweep across the room. To avoid damage from the attack, simply stand on the row/column that doesn't have sunfire on it.
*'''Sunfire Sweeper:''' Metzli will unleash two waves of sunfire simultaneously while also summoning two white portals to her sides. To avoid damage from this attack, wait for the sunfire wave to close in, then stand on the white portal to teleport behind it.
*'''Triple Projectile: Same as the one used by Lucius, except used twice in a row.
*'''Moonfire Waves:''' Same as '''Sunfire Waves'''.
*'''Moonfire Sweeper:''' Same as '''Sunfire Sweeper'''.

After every sweeper attack, Metzli will change combat styles, this time using magic. Upon using '''Moonfire Sweeper''', she will revert to ranged. Pray accordingly to minimise damage.

Upon reaching 10% of her health, Metzli will enter an enrage phase, conjuring a wall of fire in all cardinal directions. She will not use any auto-attacks. Instead, she will target the quadrant that the player and Itzla are on. A white portal will additionally spawn to move to the next quadrant, avoiding damage from the attack. Itzla will react to the mechanic but will be unable to attack her.

Upon reaching 0 health, Metzli will run further into the cavern. Head down the stairs to the west then search the skeleton on the lower level for a [[Stone tablet (The Final Dawn)|stone tablet]], revealing that human refugees assisted the Old Ones (seemingly referred to as the Kuhu) in constructing the archive's defences. Continue around this path to the north to the next entrance to reach the final chamber. Dying after defeating Metzli will not require the player to repeat the fight.

''Note: With 75 [[Agility]], you can cross the [[Pillar (Ruins of Mokhaiotl)|pillar]] shortcut on the north side of the chamber where you fought Metzli, to more quickly reach the final chamber. However, you will still need to return and take the stone tablet to complete the quest.''

In the final chamber, Metzli will be shocked to discover that there were no archives at all. Prince Itzla tells her that the gift might never have existed or was never meant for them to access. As he finishes, Furia appears from behind, calls Metzli a traitor, and throws a [[rune knife]] at her, finishing her off. You and Prince Itzla will then take Furia back to Queen Zyanyi. As you exit the chamber, you will be prompted to explore the area fully before returning.

Inspect the statues at the entrance to the final chamber, and then search the skeleton for a second [[Stone tablet (The Final Dawn)|stone tablet]], which reveals that the chamber was indeed named Mokhaiotl and was in fact an archive, but during its construction, something ancient awakened deep in the archive and destroyed it entirely. Lastly, attempt to return to the chamber, resulting in a message appearing that a [[Doom of Mokhaiotl|horrifying screech]] can be heard within, and the player will automatically return to the crypt. Do not forget to inspect the statues in the area to complete the investigation sequence and automatically return to the crypt.

Queen Zyanyi orders to take Furia to prison in Fortis for her betrayal, presumably with death, but Prince Itzla stops her from doing so, believing that while the cult is mostly leaderless, there are still supporters from the shadows. As Metzli and Ennius had been martyred, Prince Itzla suggests sparing Furia for the time being, which she accepts, seeing it as a sign of his growth throughout the entire ordeal.

Queen Zyanyi and Captain Vibia will then return to Fortis with Furia in tow. You and Prince Itzla will exchange some banter, and he'll thank you for sticking by him, showing his gratitude by handing down the [[Arkan blade]], which was passed down to him from his grandfather. 

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===Starting off===
The quest begins in the [[Auburn Pub]]. Players have several options for reaching [[Auburnvale]]:

* Taking [[Renu]] to Auburnvale, then running south-west
* Using [[Fairy rings|fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|AIS}}, then running north over the bridge
* Teleporting to [[Nemus Retreat]] with the [[Pendant of Ates]] (if the nearby statue has been unlocked), then running north into the town

Once inside the pub, read the [[Notice board (Shadows of Custodia)|notice board]] hanging on the wall. You notice that the board is covered entirely in missing person posters, and decide to try and look for the missing people.

===Auburn alert===
{{Needed|A [[fishing rod]] (or [[oily fishing rod]]) and one empty [[inventory space]]|recommended=[[Stamina potion]]}}
After starting the quest, talk to [[Marcus]] nearby in the bar, who will tell you about a strange man by the sea claiming the missing people were abducted. The man that Marcus is referring to is [[Ictus]], who is found north-east of the sawmill. Talk to Ictus, and he'll tell you that creatures walking on two legs have been scraping against the walls at night. Besides Marcus and Ictus, you can talk to [[Captain Ariadna]], the [[Bartender (Auburn Pub)|bartender]], and the [[Shopkeeper (Auburnvale)|shopkeeper]] for more information about what's happening. Speaking to <u>at least</u> one of them is required to continue. If you don't have a hammer and fishing rod yet, it is recommended to talk to the shopkeeper in the general store as you can buy both while you're there.
[[File:Shadows of Custodia - investigating the house.png|thumb|250px|Investigating the outside of the house.]]
Next, go to the house west of the Auburn Pub and speak to [[Francis (Auburnvale)|Francis]] or [[Aemilia]]. If you haven't talked to Marcus and Ictus yet, the two will refuse to believe you want to help them. Once you've convinced them you genuinely want to help, they will mention that their boys vanished whilst playing upstairs one night. They also mention strange behaviour from the ents that night, who usually pass by their house on a regular path; on the night of the disappearance, however, the ents did not approach their house, as if the ents were avoiding something. 

You will ask if you can search their house for clues, and they will allow you to look around. Go outside and investigate the scratched [[Wall (Shadows of Custodia)|wall]]. You will notice strange claw marks and a [[Puddle (Shadows of Custodia)|puddle]] of mysterious liquid; follow the trail south-west outside the town (you don't need to inspect the puddles), until you reach a river with an item hanging on a [[Plank (Shadows of Custodia)|plank]]. With a fishing rod (one spawns south-west of the log, and the [[general store]] nearby sells them as well), retrieve the [[wet fabric scrap]] and bring it to Francis or Amelia, who will confirm that it matches what one of their sons was likely wearing at the time. 
[[File:Shadows of Custodia - the lost sons.png|thumb|250px|The player finds the two injured boys.]]
After showing the scrap, head back out of town, and follow the path, which will loop around to the northern end of the [[Custodia Pass]]. South-east of the rowboat will be a [[Cave (Shadows of Custodia)|cave]]; this is the [[Stalker Den]], in which you will find the two boys. Speak to the [[injured boy]] deeper inside, and you will automatically bring them back to town, with Francis and Aemilia thanking you for saving them.

===Helping around town===
{{Needed|Four [[maple logs]], a [[hammer]], and four [[willow longbow]]s}}

When you ask to speak to the boys about what happened to them, Aemilia and Francis will say that they're still recovering and refuse to let you. They'll ask you to inform Captain Ariadna of what happened, and when you ask if there's any other way you can help, they'll mention that the scratched wall needs to be reinforced so that the boys aren't abducted again. Use four [[maple logs]] and a [[hammer]] to reinforce the scratched wall on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}. [[Maple trees]] can be found around town, with a [[hammer]] spawn located just to the north, in the building with a furnace.

Next, talk to Captain Ariadna by the town gate, and she'll ask if you saw anyone else in the caves. You will then offer to help prepare the guards. Captain Ariadna will tell you that their fletcher, [[Antos]], has gone missing and they are in need of bows; she will request four [[willow longbow]]s for her team. You can grab them from the nearby [[bank]], fletch them using the trees and [[flax]] in the area, or use the nearby [[Quetzal Transport System|quetzal]] to travel to [[Tal Teklan]] and buy them from [[Arcuani's Archery Supplies]].

After giving Captain Ariadna the bows and reinforcing the scratched wall, [[Shas]] and [[Etz]] will be well enough to talk to you. Talk to them on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of Aemilia and Francis's house and they will tell you that Antos was also in the cave with them. After telling you that he was dragged deeper into the cave, they will ask you to rescue him.

===Rescuing Antos===
{{Needed|Combat gear}}
[[File:Shadows of Custodia - fighting strange creatures.png|thumb|250px||A player fighting some strange creatures.]]
Grab some combat gear and head back to the cave entrance from earlier. Inside, run east to a small chamber offshoot to find Antos; you will try to get him out, but three level 93 [[Strange creature (Shadows of Custodia)|strange creatures]] will attack. Activate [[Protect from Melee]] to reduce almost all damage (note that this section of the cave is a [[multicombat area]]). The creatures will also occasionally inflict a [[bleed]], but standing still will reduce the rate at which it deals damage.

After killing the last of the strange creatures, Antos will ask about the others, but you will sadly tell him that they were all dead. You will automatically bring him back to town; after the dialogue, inform Captain Ariadna of the monsters and that you found Antos, and she will thank you for your help. 

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
[[File:Scrambled! - the fall.webm|thumb|width=210x210|Lumpty Mumpty...]]

===Humphrey Dumphrey Sat On A Wall===
[[File:Scrambled! - a great fall.png|thumb|250px|Oh <nowiki>********</nowiki>, Mumpty Rumpty had a great fall.]]
Head to the temple of [[Tal Teok]], just north of [[Tal Teklan]]. You will find a tourist named [[Alan (Scrambled!)|Alan]], alongside his egg-shaped friend [[Humphrey Dumphrey|Humpy Plumpy]], who has chosen to occupy the temple as a squatter. He will ask that you stay as a guest and insists he prepare a feast, and requests you to look after Wumty Scrumpty while he gathers the food.

As soon as he leaves however, gravity claims the life of Hampty and results in a great fall. Inspect Gumty on the ground, which prompts you to head back to Tal Teklan to look for help. Talking to any citizen there will direct you to [[King (Tal Teklan)|King]], the local bartender for [[The King's Inn]].

===All the King's Men===
Speak to King located in the inn about your predicament. She will tell you that she has to stay and man the bar, but has capable men who are up to the task. She will direct you to three people.

====Acatzin====
[[Acatzin]] is also in the inn. He will help you as soon as he gets his axe back from the [[Blacksmith (Tal Teklan)|blacksmith]]. Head south-west to the furnace and speak to the blacksmith, who will tell you that his whetstone has broken and needs repairing.

Take the hammer nearby and repair the whetstone. He will then give you [[Acatzin's axe]] (not knowing that it is his) and ask you to repair it instead. Repair the axe on the whetstone then return to Acatzin and he will be on his merry way to Tal Teok.

Before leaving, take the empty bowl on the table.

====Nezketi====
[[Nezketi]] is found at the temple directly south of the inn. In order to help you, he will need to be on top of his game - he will need tea made from [[damiana leaves]]. Agree to get his tea, and he will give you an empty cup.

[[Damiana]] can be found directly outside of the south-eastern walls of Tal Teklan. While you are there, head a bit further south-west and pick up the two [[plank]]s.

Acquire a [[bowl of water]]; if you didn't take a bowl earlier, pick it up on a table in [[The King's Inn]]. A fountain is right outside to fill the bowl. Use the [[damiana leaves]] on the bowl of water, then head into the [[Tal Teklan General Store]] just south of the bank, and use the bowl on the oven to boil the [[damiana water]]. Finally, use the bowl of tea on the empty cup to finally create [[damiana tea]].

Head back to the temple and talk to Nezketi, who you will automatically give the tea to. Freshly energised, he will depart for the temple immediately after.

====Kauayotl====
[[File:Scrambled! - repairing racing cart.png|thumb|250px|Repairing Kauayotl's racing cart.]]
From the temple, head directly east to the eastern entrance of Tal Teklan, where you will find [[Kauayotl]] with a damaged cart. In order to help you, he will first need to sort out his racing cart. Offer to help repair it, and he will tell you what you'll need:
* Two planks - if you did not pick up two planks earlier, there are two spawns south of the city.
* Nails - search the [[Blacksmith (Tal Teklan)|blacksmith's]] workbench for 20 [[iron nails]].
* Hammer - spawns on the table south-west of the workbench
* Saw - spawns on a table in [[Arcuani's Archery Supplies]] just south of the blacksmith.

Return to Kauayotl, repair the damaged cart, and speak to him again to have him on his way to the temple.

===Putting Humphrey together again===
Head back north to Tal Teok and speak to any of the three men. It quickly becomes apparent that all of King's men couldn't put Pumpty Lumpty together again, and that replacing him is the only option. However, the three argue over which type of egg is suitable: a large chicken's, a dragon's, or a... jaguar's. You will offer to get all three and have them pick a suitable one.

Head to the small chicken farm directly south of the Tal Teok temple in the north of Tal Teklan, and search the pile of eggs. A level-16 [[large chicken]] will attack; defeat it, then search the eggs again to obtain a [[large egg]].
[[File:Scrambled! - red dragon safespot.png|thumb|250px|Safespotting the red dragon using their own eggs.]]
The entrance to the [[Dragon Nest]] is found to the south-east of Tal Teok temple, across the river. Once inside, make your way to the south-east and search the pile of eggs. A level-106 [[Red dragon (Scrambled!)|red dragon]] will attack. Players can safespot the dragon using the eggs; defeat it, then search the eggs again to obtain a [[Dragon egg (Scrambled!)|dragon egg]].

Head back outside, and run eastwards until you reach a campsite. Search the pile of eggs, and a level-88 [[Black jaguar (Scrambled!)|black jaguar]] will attack; as it has routefinding capabilities, you will have to trick the jaguar by standing next to tropical tree and a fern to safespot it. After triumphing over the egglaying jaguar search the eggs again to obtain a [[jaguar egg]].
[[File:Scrambled! - egg piecing solution.png|thumb|250px|The nearly-reassembled Lumpty Mumpty.]]
Return to Tal Teok and speak to each of King's men, who will each paint the egg to resemble Rumpty Bumpty as best they can. Once all three eggs have been given, a cutscene will play in which the eggs are judged. The chicken egg is deemed too small to be Wumty Scrumpty, the dragon egg's innate heat is melting the paint, and the jaguar egg is deemed to be the best replacement for Mumpty Rumpty.

However, gravity is a cruel mistress and claims the lives of all the eggs, resulting in three additional great falls. With no options left, you and King's men must put Humphrey Dumphrey together again.

There are many pieces to reassemble, but players can hover over the puzzle piece icon to view the solution. When a piece is rotated in the correct orientation and placed in the correct location, it will stay in place indicating the correct placement.

Upon putting Scrumpty Lumpy back together again, a cutscene will play in which you thank King's men before they take their leave, and Alan returns none the wiser. As you head down to help him bring in the food, he reflects on his life, finally sure of himself and his place in the world. However, gravity is apparently out for blood, giving Alan a great fall.

'''Note:''' Players who wish to keep [[Alan's bones]] as a souvenir should ensure they do not have a [[bonecrusher]] or [[bonecrusher necklace]] on their person before fixing Bumpty Numpty, as the bonecrusher deems the player responsible for his death and will automatically crush his bones.

==Trivia==
* This quest is a reference to the nursery rhyme ''{{WP|Humpty Dumpty}}''. The lyrics to the rhyme ("Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall. / Humpty Dumpty had a great fall. / All the king's horses and all the king's men / Couldn't put Humpty together again.") mirror the plot of the quest.
** When King quotes this rhyme, the player will reply "What's a [[horse]]?", to which King replies she has no idea. 
* Scrambled! contains the most uses of profanity in any ''Old School'' quest, necessitating the use of asterisks and the profanity filter in this article and one of its screenshots. The full uncensored dialogue is available in the quest transcript.
** The original draft for the quest would have had the player character drop a {{WP|Fuck|hard 'F'}} at its conclusion, but this was toned down to the currently used swearword prior to release.{{CiteDiscord|author=Mod Ash|url=https://discord.com/channels/324132423636090880/431834766325841920/1397878674413588590|date=24 July 2025|quote=(...) For what it's worth, the original draft had the hard F in it instead, and I rather regret the requirement to tone it down.|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27963194#chat-messages-431834766325841920-1397878674413588590|archivedate=22 March 2026}}
* Alongside [[Contact!]] and [[Wanted!]], this is one of three quests which uses an exclamation mark in its title.
* Alan's obsession with the egg and its features appears to be a reference to the 2000 film ''{{WP|Cast Away}}'', which has been [[Wilhelm|referenced before]] in game scenery.
* The dialogue lines "But it's not possible!" and "No, it's necessary..." towards the end of the quest are a reference to the 2014 film ''{{WP|Interstellar (film)|Interstellar}}''.
* King was originally intended to be a male NPC, in reference to the original nursery rhyme. A miscommunication between the developers resulted in King being made a female NPC instead, but this was kept in due to it fitting the humorous tone of the quest.{{CiteVideo|author=Old School RuneScape|title=Varlamore: The Final Dawn Q&A <nowiki>|</nowiki> OSRS Livestream July 24th|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5JCyAOzIhcM&t=3272s|timestamp=54:32-54:52|date=24 July 2025|site=YouTube|notes=|name=}}
* The choreography for the quest was done by [[Mod Hend]].
* If the player is wearing the [[Bonecrusher necklace]], the [[Alan's bones]] will automatically be buried suggesting that the player is at fault for Alan's death.
